tei:div.tei:p: 305) ༄༅/ mnyam med sgam po mchog gi sprul ba'i skus 'ja' tshon zab gter chog khrig gis dri med gnang ba'i lan du gsol ba snyil bzhi chu skyes ces bya ba bzhugs so/

306) rgyal ba'i thugs rje ma lus gcig bsdoms pa// pad 'byung bi ma zla 'od gzhon nu rnams// snyigs ma mtha' skyabs mchog sprul pa'i skur byon pa'i// zhabs zung rtsibs stong 'bar ba spyi bos mchod/ /gang gsung bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar zeg ma yis// bdag blo'i ku muṭa mngon par phyes mdzad mthus// lhag bsam ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i 'dzum phreng 'di// mos ldan mgul ba'i rgyan du byin gyis rlabs// ༈ de yang bka'i bdud rtsi'i lhug par stsal ba'i don 307) skor ji bzhin du/ spyir gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos tshul/ sgos su rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zab gter/ khyad par yang zab dkon mchog spyi mdus skor gyi dgongs don babs lugs rnams grub mtha'i thun mong bdag dang mi mthun pa'i tshul rnams la/ gdams ngag phal mo che dag som nyi'i 'khyog la 'phyang mo nyug cing*/ mkhas pa'i ming khur 'dzin kyang chos tshul gyi spyan/ rgyang thung ba dag ni log lta'i 'khun bu ldir bar byed pa ches mang bar byung dang 'byung 'gyur rnams ni rang rang gi bgo 308) skal du zad phyir thabs kyi dben mod kyi/ theg pa'i yang rtser mngon par 'phags pa'i chos tshul gyi 'jings la mos pa'i blo dang yang pa'i khyon gyi thugs mnga' rnams ni chos dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don la dbang 'byor tshe yin lugs ji bzhin pa khong du chud par gyur ba chos nyid lags te/ rdzogs pa chen po nam mkha' che'i rgyud las/ rgya mtsho chen por chu rlung kun 'bab cing*/ rgya mtsho'i nang du ro gcig gnas pa ltar/ chos rnams rdzogs pa chen por 'dus gsal zhing*/ ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i ngang du gnas// ces gsungs pa bzhin lags mod kyi/ de'i phyir na skal dman rnams kyis ji ltar log par bltas shing brjod kyang*/ zab don gyi dgongs pa ni rang lugs sor bzhag gi gzhung lam du bzhugs pa nyid byin rlabs mi nyams pa'i gnad don snying po nyid du grub la/

de dag gi tshul la ji ltar 'jug cing 309) lag tu blang thabs kyi chog sgrig skyabs mchog nyid kyis legs par brtsal ba 'di las lhags su gyur ba zhig ni rmongs pa bdag 'dras 'bul bar rngo mi thogs shing*/ 'di nyid nang gses la/ bka' phebs ltar/ phyi ltar pad+ma 'od 'bar du bsgrub pa ni dkon mchog spyi mdus nyid dang*/ nang ltar dkyil 'khor lnga ldan du bsgrub pa ni zhi khro shes don snying po/ gsang ba bye brag so sor bsgrub pa ni gdams ngag gi mos blo dang bstun pa'i sgos sgrub/ yang gsang hūm̐ nag me 'bar du bsgrub pa ni spros med chig dril rgyun khyer du nyams su len pa'i dbang du mdzad mod kyang*/ da lam bka' stsal gyi dngos don la ni/ chos bka' yongs rdzogs kyi tshig sgrig 'di ka'i sngon 'gro bar chad bsal phyir bgegs gtor mtshams gcod bsod nams gsog phyir skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sogs dang*/ thun mong 310)khyad par gyi mchod gtor byin rlabs/ nyams chags sbyong phyir rdor sems yig brgya/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i rim pa rnams la ni zhu dgos par ma gyur la dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa'i sngon 'dir/ chos spyi 'gro ltar na mngon byang lnga'am/ cho ga spyi 'gro ltar na mngon byang lnga'am/ cho ga gsum skad cig dran rdzogs sogs kyi bskyed tshul du ma dang*/ mdor bsdus pa'i dbang du yang*/ ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las/ nya dag myur du 'phar ba ltar/ de bzhin stong pa'i 'od gsal las/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba bzhengs par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ swa bhā ba'am shu n+ya ta sogs sngags la brten pa'i chos nyid gdod ma'i dbyings las rang gsal ye shes kyi lha bskyed dgos mod kyi/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsang ba'i las gzhung mtha' dag par ni/ dang por bde bzhin nyid rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab stong pa

311)nyid yum gyi tshul dang*/ gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin sgyu ma lta bu'i rtsal mdangs ni thabs snying rje chen po thabs kyi tshul dang*/ gsum pa dpa' bar 'gro ba rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni zung 'jug sral gyi tshul du/ yig 'bru phyag mtshan nam rgyu'i he ru ka sogs spro bsdu rnam rol gyi sgo nas lha tshogs bskyed pa 'ba' shig 'byung na'ang*/ rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po'i gter chos 'di dag phal che bar ting 'dzin gsum so sor ma phye bar gzhi stong pa nyid kho na las skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed tshul nyid gsungs snang ba'i phyir/ des na gong gi 'phra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi 'jug thob der/ lha gang sngon la bskyed kyang*/ 'di ltar snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun/ zhes pa'i sho lo ka sngags bcas brjod pa nyid dgos par go la/ ༈ de nas lha bskyed pa dngos la/ bka' rin po ji 312) ltar phebs bzhin/ chos spyi babs dang bstun na chos longs sprul gsum gyi nges pa dang sbyar ba'i bskyed tshul ni da lta'i chog sgrigs su gnang ba bzhin shin tu 'thad par gda' lags na'ang*/ ༈ gu ru nyid kyi sgrub gzhung phal mo cher ni phyi sprul sku nang longs sku/ gsang ba chos skur bsgrub pa'i go rim 'ba' shig gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid la'ang yi dam gyi lha gang dang gang bskyed cing bsgrub kyang don dam par bla ma'i slob dpon nyid kyi ngo bor gdod nas lhun gyis grub par thag chod pa'i nges shes med mi rung phyir/ thog mar bla ma'i bsgrub pa gzhung srang la/ slar bla ma nyid lhag pa'i lhar bzhengs nas dngos grub kyi don 'bras stsal bar mdzad pa'i nges shes kyi sgo nas yi dam gang mod bsgrub par gsungs pa/ 'di gsang sngags rnying lugs kyi dgongs don dmigs 313) bsal lta bur gda' bas na/ thog mar gu ru zhi ba nyid kyi las gzhung 'dzab kyi rim pa yan chad sgrub par byas la/

de nas longs sku thugs rje chen po dang*/ de nas chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgrub gzhung bsrang ba nyid 'gab par mthong lags te/ tshul 'di la gu ru nyid kyi zhal nas kyang*/ nga yi rjes 'jug skal ldan las canakun/ bla ma bsgrub dang yi dam gang ri rigs/ mkha' 'gro la sogs ji ltar bsgrub 'dod kyang*/ ngo bo nga la rnam pa gzhan gyi gzung*/ sku mdog phyag mtshan stangs stabs la sogs par// sgrub par gyur na gang 'dod 'grub gyur zhing*// ji ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub rtsol bar nus/ de tshe the tshom yid gnyis spangs la sgrub// ces gsungs phyir dang*/ bskyed tshul yang chos spyi ltar yi dam gcig gi sgrub mchod grub nas de nyid gshegs bstim bsdu ba sogs byas rjes/ yang 314) gzhan zhig gi bskyed chog dbu 'jug pa'i las rim lta bu ni 'di dag tu gtan nas dgos par ma gsungs phyir/ chog gzhung phyi ma gang dang gang gi lha bskyed pa'i skabs la bab pa na gu ru rin po che nyid skad cig gis lha de nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa'i tshul du mos pa kho nas 'grub pa lags te/ de ltar yang gu ru'i zhal nas/ bdag ni gang ltar mos pa'i skur snang zhing// snang yang skye med rdo rje snying po'i sku// dag pas snang ba de dang mthun par bsgom// sgon dang bsgom bya'ang blo yi spyod yul yin// legs par rtogs na nga nyid kun tu bzang*// don dam ma bcos thig ler gcig pa'i sku// de nyid rang dang gnyis su med par ltos// ces dang*/ dkyil 'khor thams cad bde bshegs thugs kyi ngang*// ma skyes rdo rje lhag pa'i lha ru mthong*// rang byung ye shes rang shar yi dam lha// gu ru'i sku yi rnam 'gyur nyid yin pas// sgrub thabs mthar thug yin no rtag tu bsgom// nga dang 315) gnyis su med par mngon sangs rgyas// zhes gsungs zhing*/ ༈ de bzhin du/ bdag mdun tha dad rim can du sgom pa thams cad thun mong ba'i gdul bya dang*/

dbang po 'bring man chad la dgongs nas bstan pa lags kyi/ dbang rnon skal rab kyi blo ldan pa ni bdag bskyed gnyis po tsam du zad de/ ji ltar snod kyi 'jig rten du snang ba thams cad ni 'od gsal dbyings kyi zhing khams brgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba'i gzhal yas su gdod nas grub pa dang*/ bcud kyi sems can du srid tshad ni kun bzang bla ma'i rnam rol sku gsum ye shes kyi lha tshogs su rang byung zhing*/ de lta bu'i tshul lam gnas tshul 'di nyid kyi dbang du ni/ phyi ltar snod dang bcud/ nang ltar gzhal yas dang lha tshogs/ gsang ba sku dang zhing khams/ de kho na nyid du dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med kyi ngang du 'du 'bral med par mnyam pa nyid du gdod nas dag pa chen por rdzogs tshul ni/ gzhung thams cad las kyang*/ sku dang zhing khams 316) ye nas 'du 'bral med// ces sogs gsungs pas gsal mod kyi// ༈ de'i phyir na bdag mdun tha dad du lta ba'i skabs thog ma lags pas/ cir snang dag pa rab 'byams gsang gsum mi zad rgyan 'khor gyi klong nas cho ga'i tshul tsam gyi gsal 'debs su gdab pa dang*/ 'on te 'di lta bu'i tshul ni rtogs pa mngon gyur gyi rnal 'byor chen po dag gi spyod yul yin tshe/ dang po las kyi gdams ngag rnams kyis ji ltar bya zhe na/ de lta bu'i don ji lta ba khong du chud par ma gyur kyang*/ chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la mos pa rgya chen pos kyang 'grub par gyur ba ni chos nyid kyi bden pa'i stobs lags shing*/ de'i ngang nas lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs gang ji snyed pa thams cad rang rig bla ma'i rol rtsal yin la yin par blo nges pa kho nas don kun 'grub par 'gyur ba ste/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ nga la brten nas tshogs 317) gnyis kyi// yon tan bsgrub pa thams cad kyang*// nga yin nga ni kun tu bzang*/ /kunang kun la khyab cing gdal// kun byed kun rig kun tu gsal// zhes dang*/

nga yi sku nyid zhi ba'am// yang na khro bor bsgom kyang rung*// phyag rgyan gcig pa'am gnyis/ zhal phyag mang nyung ci lta bur/ sgoms kyang 'khrul ba yong ye med// ci phyir nga ni kun tu snang*// nga nyid gtso dang 'khor du bcas// mang nyung blo yi bye brag gis// ji ltar nus pa sgoms kyang rung*// zhes sogs gsungs phyir/ des na cir snang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor nyid du bsgrub pa'i bdag bskyed kho nas khog phubs te/ yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad bla ma'i rnam 'gyar du shes par bya ba dang*/ mchod gtor tshogs 'khor sogs kyang rang byung rang la mchod pa'am/ lha la lha mchod/ chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis med du shes 318) pa ni 'di skabs kyi dgongs don snying po lags pa dang*/ yang gal te zhi khro nges don gyi bshags skongs lta bu byed pa'i tshe na ni/ bdag mdun tha dad/ sa'i bsgrub tshul de ka'i rang gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ gzhan yang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'am/ rab gnas dang gshin don sogs khyad par ba'i bya ba bsgrub dgos pa'i skabs su ni bdag mdun so so las kyang mdun bskyed gtso bor bsgrub tshul nichos spyi 'gro dang mtshungs pa nyid lags/ ༈ bdag bskyed 'ba' shig pa'i skabs nyid la'ang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams ni gong du smos pa bzhin dbyer med kyi mos blo'i ngang nas snga phyi'i rim pa yang chog sgrig nyid ltar grub rjes/ bka' srung chos skyong gi rigs rnams ni bdag bskyed kyi rnam par sprul pa yang sprul gyi bye brag bka' nyan pho nya'i tshul du rang gi mdun du gus pas 'khod par dmigs nas/ 319) mchod bstod dang phrin las bcol bar bya zhing*/ de dag gi gtor ma ni bar 'dir mi bskyel te/ thams cad kyi mthar zor bzlog sogs drag las kyi skabs yin na de dang mthun par zor du 'phangs shing*/ rgyun gyi bskang gso lta bu la ni 'chad mdo'i mthar gtor ma rnams phyir 'bul ba lags te/

'di'i dgos don ni/ srung ma'i gtor ma rnams phyir 'bul ba dang mtshungs par de rnams dgyes par 'gyur bar bshad cing*/ gtor ma ma phul gyi ring la de rnam kyang dam tshig gi gral du 'dus nas bzhugs pa yin phyir/ tshogs dag bskang ba sogs mtha' dag gis mnyes par byas nas mthar 'chad mdo sogs kyis sngon gyi dam tshig bsgrag cing gtor ma phul nas gshegs su gsol ba lags/ ༈ chog sgrig 'di'i chos srung rnams kyis go rim kyang gzhan ni 'di kho na ltar 320) las/ rdo rje de mo'i gtor chog ni thams cad kyi rjes la byed na 'thad par sems te/ ci'i phyir na/ pho rgyud dag mo rgyud kyi khyad par dang*/ de las kyang mgon po ma ning sogs ni ye shes pa nyid yin pa dang*/ gza' dang dam can yang don la don la rnam pa ltar na ye shes 'jig rten so mtshams su bzhugs par bshad la/ de mo ni ngo bo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro yin na'ang*/ gnas skabs su 'jig rten pa kho na'i tshul 'dzin phyir/ des na rjes mar byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de bzhin lags/ lar yang rnying ma'i chos skor mang por bdag mdun zung 'jug tu bsgrub pa'i tshul 'di kho nar 'byung ba thugs la ma shong bar/ rgyud de'i dgongs pa ma yin par sngags btsun skye bo dag gi blo bzor 'dug gsungs mkhan dang*/ las byang tshar gcig gi bdag mdun bum gsum ga'i go chod par 'dod pa yang rnying hrul ba dag gi zog chos su gda' gsungs/ 321) pa dang*/ dbang bskur gyi skabs dag tu'ang*/ gsar ma'i phyag bzhes ltar slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas slob ma la ji ltar bskur ba bzhin gyi bdag 'jug mi byed par/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bdag 'jug gis chog par 'dod pa yang rnying ma'i chos gzhung dang gdams ngag rnams tshad ldan du mi 'gyur tshul sogs kyi bka' dkyon sna tshogs mdzad mkhan snga phyi dpag med byung mod kyang*/ theg pa'i bye brag dang rgyud sde'i rim pa mtha' yas pa'i tshul gyi thugs bsam ma gnang ba'i skyon sha stag tu 'dug na'ang*/

so so'i bzhed pa dang ni ma mthun/ rnying ma'i rgyud kyi lung khungs rjod rung rgyud nyid kyang tshad mar mi 'dzin tshe/ bka' dkyon mdzad pa po rnams sku dbang gis gcod pa las gzhan pa'i thabs ma mchis mod kyi/ gsar ma'i rgyud sde dus kyi 'khor lo man 322) chad thams cad ni ma hā yo ga'i sde mtshan yin/ rnying lugs la de'i steng du a nu a ti sogs yod phyir chos skad mi mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan ni de lta bu'i khyad par yin na'ang*/ blo la mi shong mkhan rnams la brjod pa'i dgos pa nam yang ma mchis shing*/ rnying ma bar rlom pa'i gti thug 'ga' zhig kyang*/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi las byang 'di la bzhugs gsol ma tshang 'dug zer ba sogs kyang gnang ba ni/ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha// zhes sogs kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa dang*/ don dam par ni/ rang sems bla ma lha ru gnas// zhes pa ltar lags kyang gnas skabs gdul bya'i mos blo dang bstun nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'i tshul tsam bgyis pa de yang rang rang la dbyer med bstim zhing dam ye bsres tshar nas phyi rol du bzhugs su gsol rgyu ga la 'ongs kyang*/ chos kyi go rgya ma 'khrol ba'i rigs la ni/ log pa'i 323) lam la mtha' med phyir// de dag 'dir ni spro bya min// zhes/gsungs pa ltar gyur mod/ ༈ 'gag don du ci zhu na/ bka'i phebs tshogs ltar gyi chog sgrig gnang tshul la/ thog mar dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ de nas thugs rje chen po/ snang ba mtha' yas/ de nas rta phag rnams rim pa bzhin dang*/ 'gur drag kyang zhi ba nyid kyi mjug thogs tu byas na'ang rung mod kyi/ drag las zor zlog sogs las byed kyi lhar mdzad dgos pa'i dbang gi skabs 'dir 'dug pa shin tu 'thad pa dang*/ de nas bka' brgyad dang bcas te yi dam gyi las gzhung thams cad grub rjes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma dang*/ de nas bka' srung rnams rim can du bya zhing*/ de mthar tshogs las bskang ba sogs dang*/

drag las gtso bor byed na bsgral las stabs pa/ drag po bka' brgyad seng gdong chos skyong sogs 324) kyi drag bskul dang*/ sgo phye lam bstan/ 'chad mdo/ gtor zor/ bstan skyong*/ gtor gzhong gi 'og tu dam sri gnon pa'i bro sogs bya ba dang*/ drag las sgrub skabs ma yin ni tshogs lha'i mjug tu 'chad mdo byas la gtor ma rnams 'bul zhing*/ bshal chus bstan pa bskyang*/ mthar rjes chog gi rim pa thams cad ni gzhung nyid ltar mdzad pa dang*/ ༈ gong du gu ru zhi ba'i 'dzab kyi mjug tu tshe sgrub kyi 'dzab ni long khyab dang bstun zhing*/ dbang dang 'brel na ni nges par dgos te tshe 'gugs kyang mdzad la// dbang dang mi 'brel na bdag bskyed rkyang sgrub yin tshe/ bum pa tshe ril tshe chang sogs kyang dngos su bsham mi dgos mod kyi/ de dag gi dbang tshig rnams chog sgrig gi phyag dper 'god pa gnang 'dug pa ni/ dbang gi dus su slob dpon gyi brjod pa ma gtogs cho ga'i sgrig rim la ni mi dgos pa 325) dgongs pa mnga' ltar lags/ mdor na las byang de dag so so'i lha bskyed pa thams cad gu ru nyid lha de dag gi rnam par bzhengs pa tsam ma gtogs/ re re la gshegs bsdu sogs bsdu sogs kyi spros pa gtan nas mi 'tshal ba ni rgyud sde gong mar gyur pa'i khyad don lags pa dang*/ ༈ lo chen rin bzang gi rgyud sde'i rim pa so so'i lugs ltar mdzad pa dang*/ jo bos thams cad gcig tu dril thabs gnang ba de gnyis gdams ngag rim gyis pa dang gcig car ba'i khyad don lta bur 'dug mod kyi/ 'dir ni chog gzhung 'di dag thams cad rgyud sde gong ma sha stag yin pa'i tshul yang mkhyen pa ye shes kyi klong chen por bzhugs par mdzad du gsol/

༈ de ltar yang rje nyid rgyal ba pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul du byon pa lags tshe/ chos tshul 'di dag gi gnas la mi mkhyen mi gzigs pa 326) rdul phran phra rab tsam lta ga la zhig ste/ phyi rabs rjes 'jug gi gdul bya la dgongs nas/ bdag la gsang sngags rnying lugs kyi babs dang 'gros la bstun pa'i skabs don smra bar gyis shig pa'i bka' rin po che ji ltar bstsal pa spyi bor blangs te/ rang gi go tshod dang rig 'dzin chen po 'ja' tshon snying po nyid kyi phyag bzhes mthong pa brgyud pa ltar/ ci nus su yi ger bkod nas phul ba 'di yi dge tshogs ston ga'i zla ltar dkar ba'i mthu nus kyis mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rtsa gsum dbyer med bla mchog gi go 'phang la 'khod par gyur cig tshul 'di gangs can sgrub rgyud mtha' dag gi /gtsug rgyan mnyam med zla 'od gzhon nu yi// seng ge'i khri la yang dag gzi 'bar ba'i// rgyal mchog sprul pa'i sku de'i bka' bzhin du// snyigs mtha'i ngang tshul la skyo'i spong ba la// sna tshogs rang grol 327) rgan pos kong rong mthil// rgod tshang brag gi bya skyibs ga la bar// bris nas phul dges gzhan phan 'grub par shog / 1$0000180ces chu yos rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs mngon par 'phel ba'i dus dge bar bris pa maṅga lam/ 1$10002501$0000250yang re shig gi tshe mtshungs bral mchog gi sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyid dri ba'i chab shog stsal ba'i nang tshan du/ gsang sngags bla med kyi dkyil mchog thams cad du gsungs pa'i nang mchod kyi gtso bo bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa dang*/ rak+ta dmar gyi mchod pa gnyis kyi ngo bo dang dbye ba sogs la gzhung dang bla ma tha dad kyi phyag bzhes ngos 'dzin sogs mila'adra ba'i khyad don gyi dri ba 'ga' zhig gnang ba'i sger don mdor bsdus kyi mchid lan ni sngon du phul grub pa 'dir ma bkod kyang*/

spyi don 'ga' zhig slar yang zhib mnan gyi tshul du snyan dbang rin po cher gsol ba ni/ ༈ de yang spyir gsang sngags kyi yo byad dam rdzas mtha' dag la re re nas thabs shes zung 'jug gi mtshan nyid rdzogs mod kyang*/ skabs 'dir sman rag gnyis po'i mtshan nyid la ni bdud rtsi ni byang chub kyi sems dkar cha thabs kyi rang bzhin gtso che bas dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su 1$10001801$0000180'di la gzhung la lar/ 'byor na gtor ma ji tsam yod pa'i grangs dang mnyam par bdud rtsi'i snod bshams par gsungs so/ 1$1000180 bshams shing*/ tshogs 'khor dang gnas khang bdag gzhan sogs snod bcud kyi dngos po kun la 'thor ba tsam gyis sgra dri 'bag gtsog nyes sgrib gdon bgegs sogs mtha' dag sel zhing byin gyis rlabs pa'i nus par ldan pa'i thabs kyi dam rdzas yin la/ ༈ rak+ta ni shes rab dmar cha yum gyi rang bzhin gtso che bas lha tshogs ma lus dgyes pa bskongs zhing dam tshig nyan po'i rgyud bskul nas rang bzhin gyis phrin las thogs 329) med du 'grub par byed pa'i lha tshogs dbang du bsdud pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas yin phyir dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon gyi char bshams pa dang*/ ༈ gtor ma ni yab yum thabs shes snang stong zung du 'jug cing gnyis med bde ba chen po'i klong du thugs dam yongs su skong bar byed pa'i dam rdzas kyi gtso bo yin phyir dbus su bshams pa'i grangs mang na ji ltar rigs par bkod de/ 'di la ni bye brag tu lha bsnyen pa'i skabs su bdag bskyed gtso che bas gtor zhal rang nyid la ston par bshams pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i skabs su mdun gtso che bas gtor zhal dkyil 'khor gyi ston pa dang*/ las sbyor kyi skabs su dmigs yul gtso che bas gtor zhal dmigs bya gang yin gyi phyogs su ston dgos par bshad pa sogs 'byung mod kyi/ ༈ des na gong gi 'phror/ sman raka gnyis 330) kyi ngo bo dang byed las bshams tshul sogs spyi tsam du ni de ltar lags shing*/

༈ bye brag tu so so'i rgyud dang sbyar tshul gyi rim pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ ding sang gi cho ga mkhan po phal mo ches ni/ snod gnyis kar chang phud phal ba re blugs pa la byin rlabs kyi tshig bshags re tsam ngag 'don byas pa des bdud rtsi dang rak+ta'i go chod pa yin rgyur rlom mod kyang*/ des ni lho phyogs thugs rje skong ma dang srung ma la 'du nus par dka' zhing*/ de ma nus tshe dgos don gyi dngos grub dang phrin las 'grub pa sogs kyang ga la 'byung ste/ cho ga'i gzugs brnyan tsam du zad mod/ lha dang dam can 'du bar byed pa la sgrub pa po dam tshig gtsang zhing lta dgongs dang ldan pa/ sngags tshig dang cho ga dag cing ting nge 'dzin gsal ba/ rdzas dang yo byad 'dzoms shing gtsang sbra 'thon pa sogs dgos par gsungs phyir ro/ ༈ des na dang por 331) bdud rtsir gzhi ma ni dza gad dpa' bo zhes chang sna lnga yin te/ nas chang*/ 'bras/ gro chang*/ rgun chang*/ me+o tog sbrang chang dang lnga yin la/ de la 'debs rgyu'i rdzas ni bdud rtsi amṛ ta ste/ spyir bdud rtsi la chos bdud rtsi/ don bdud rtsi/ rtag bdud rtsi/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi/ sman bdud rtsi dang lnga yod pa'i nang nas skabs 'dir rjes ma gnyis po la 'jug pa lags shing*/ de gnyis kyi dam rdzas bdud rtsi ni rang byung lus kyi bdud rtsi che chung gnyis/ byang sems thabs shes gnyis/ sha chen gyi dwangs ma ma dh+ya pa zhes pa'am bod skad du dbus gnas ces bya ba rkang dang*/ go ro tsa naganyis po gang rung ste/ de ltar rtsa ba'i bdud rtsi lnga ni dam rdzas bdud rtsi yin la/ de lnga'i skyobs dang 'phros du 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams la ni sman bdud rtsi zhes bya ba ste/ de ltar rtsa ba dang skyobs rnams tshang bar sbyar ba ni rtsa ba brgyad yan lag stong 332) sbyar gyi bdud rtsi yin pa dang*/ ༈ bdud rtsi lnga'i rtsa ba brgyad la'ang*/ phyi'i rtsa ba brgyad/ nang gi brgyad/ gsang ba'i brgyad/

de khon nyid kyi brgyad/ zug pa rtsa ba'i bdud rtsi brgyad/ 'dril ba stong pa'i brgyad/ gyes pa lo 'dab kyi brgyad/ smin pa 'bras bu'i bdud rtsi brgyad de/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i rtsa ba brgyad brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi yod do/ ༈ yan lag stong ni/ bdud rtsi'i rnam grangs lnga po re re la nang tshan brgya brgya yod pa bsdoms lnga brgya dang*/ de re re'i skyobs lnga brgya rnams bsdoms pas stong du 1$0000180'di dag 1$10001801$10002501$00002501$10001801$0000180gi ngos 'dzin ni bdud rtsi rgyud rnams dang sna sgrub kyi gzhung dag las 'byung mod kyi/ 'di ni yi ge mang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ so skye phal ba'i blor mi shong bas gsang sngags gsang sgrogs tu 'gyur phyir ma bkod do/ 1$10001801$1000250 tshang bar tshul bzhin sbyar nas bsgrubs pa de la bdud rtsi a mṛ ta zhes/ bod skad du 'chi med dang*/ ra sa yā na te bcud kyi len dugrags pa 'di nyid kyi nus pa ni bsam 333) gyis mi khyab ste/ bdud rtsi mchog gi lung bam so brgyad pa/ bdud rtsi 'khor lo 'bar ba/ bdud rtsi bum pa/ bdud rtsi rin po che chos nyid gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgyud sde mtha' dag nas rgya cher gsungs kyang 'bri bar ma lags mod kyi/ 'gag don mdor bsdus pa'i phan don du/ o rgyan rin po che'i gsungs las/ bder bshegs ma lus mchod pa'i rdzas// bla ma yi dam bsdud pa'i rtsi// mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying srog yin// sogs dang*/ bla ma mchod na byin rlabs 'byung*// yi dam mchod na dngos grub ster// bder bshegs mchod na thugs rje 'byung*/ mkha' 'gro mchod na lung yang ston// sgrub pa po'am sus zos kyang*/ phyi yi nad gdon sdig sgrib sel// nang gi bskyed rim ting 'dzin gsal// gsang ba rang rig chos skur rtogs// dam tshig nyams chags thams cad skongs// bcangs pas dus min 'chi ba zlog

334) gdug pa'i dug mang 'jil bar mang*// bsregs pas gdon gegs thams cad skrod// byug pas nad gdon ma lus 'joms// zhes dang*/ 'di nyid bsgrubs pa'i gnas de yang*// dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal mtshungs te// dpa' bo mtha' 'gro thams cad 'du// sa yul byin dang ldan par 'gyur// char chu phebs shing lo phyugs legs// gang du bsgrubs pa'i gnas de ru// se dad mi rnams ting 'dzin 'char// 'di zos tshe yi dus byas kyang*// pho mo bzang ngan med pa ru// rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas// de phyir mchog gi dam rdzas so/ zhes gsungs pa 'di tsam gyis don ston par 'gyur phyir/ rgyas par ni yi ge mang bar dzems nas ma bkod pas/ ༈ des na gong du brjod pa'i chang sna lnga po la a mṛ ta 'di nyid btab cing*/ gsang sngags gsar ma ltar na bdud rtsi ril bu tshul dang bsgrub pa nyid btab kyang khyad par ma 335) mchis la/ 'di'i bungs bskyed cing kha dog dri ro bzang bar bya phyir du sman bdud rtsi phyi'i rtsa ba brgyad po ka ra dang sbyar nas ci 'byor du 'debs pa yin te/ brgyad po de ni sngon dpal chen pos ru ṭa brtul ba'i tshe kho'i zag pa rgya mtshor lhung ba bdud rtsi'i shing du skyes pa'i rtsa ba klu yul du zug sdong po mi yul du skyes/ lo 'dab 'bras bu me tog rnams lha yul 'phyo ba byung zhing*/ de la sman gyi rtsa ba brgyad po tshang bar yod pa ni da lta gter nas byon pa'i gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid kyis bsgrubs pa'i dam rdzas phabs rgyun rnams la tshang bar gsungs la/ da lta ni de dang cha mthun pa'i sman raka sna brgyad po 'di 'debs par gzhung las bshad de/ rtsa ba mū la/ yal ga li shi/ shun pa shing tsha/ lo ma gan+dha tra/ me tog gur kum/ snying po ga bur dang brgyad/ 336) yin pa dang*/ de rnams kyi nang nas gzhan go sla yang*/ mū la gso rig gzhung nas 'byung ba'i pu ṣ+ka mū la zhes pa de yin phyir/

gan+dha pa tra ni bod skad du dri yi lo ma zhes pa ste/ gso rig tu ni dri bzang bzhi'i nang tshan gyi go la'am ga yu zhes pa bzhed kyang*/ skabs 'dir ni rgya gar gyi tsan dan lo ma dngos rnyed na rab/ ma rnyed na bod kyi tsan dan ni shugs pa yin phyir klungs shugs kyi lo ma gtsang ma'i rung bar bshad/ des na chang sna rnams la 'di dag tshang bar sbyar zhing a ru ra dang ka ra yang ci 'byor btab pa bshams nas byin gyis brlab dgos rung*/ chang nyid kyang da lta'i chang phal pa gtsang sbra ma byas pa'i nyag nyog gang rnyed la byed pa 'di 'dras ni ye shes kyi lha la gtsang dme'i 'dzin rtog mi mnga' yang 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can gyi tshogs rnams ru nga dang 'khu ldog rkyen pas 337) dam tshig gi rdzas dang mchod gtor la 'bags gtsog shor na de dag mi 'gyes pa'i bka' chad kyi nyes skyon ji rnyed pa yul khams spyi dang sgos su yon mchod gang yin rnams la 'phral du 'byung bas na/ dam rdzas tshogs shing gtsang bar gal che phyir/ da lta bdag cag ni rang gi nye skor du chang gi rigs kyi dri tsam rlung phyogs su yang mi bsten pa'i gshis kyis/ bdud rtsi'i rgyu ni sman sgrub byed pa'i skabs nas gong du brjod pa'i chang sna lnga po rgyu dang snad dang yo byad lag byad mkhan sogs gang spyir gtsang sbra mthun dril du byas pa'i chang de dag ro yang gzhan las khyad thon ya mtshan par 'ong snang ba de nyid rtsa ba'i sman rnams dang a mṛ ta sbyar ba'i phye ma rgyun du tshags nas/ tshes bcu sogs nam dgos kyi skabs su phye ma se chu gtsang la ka ra dang lhan cig btab 338) nas bshams pa lags/mdor na bdud rtsi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i yon tan dang nus pa ni/ ji skad du dgongs 'dul las/ bdud rtsi'i snod ni ka pā la// bcud ni byang chub sems kyi rgyun// skyen ni 'bru gsum nus pas byas// don ni skye 'chi med pa la// las ni rtog pa'i dra ba 'joms// de phyir bdud rtsi a mṛ ta// lha la phog na dgyes pa skongs// srid la phog na dmal 'du// rnal 'byor la phog sgrib pa sbyong*// dgra la phog na khal bar rlog

/bgegs la phog na myos na 'jug /rdzas na phog na nus pa bskyed// gang la phog na stobs dang ldan// zhes pa de lta bu'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs par gsungs pa lags/ gnyis pa rak+ta la yang ngo bo dang nges tshig dbye ba rnams kyi dbang du bgyi na/ rak+tī ngo bo la lnga ste/ srid pa gzhi'i rak+ta ni 'byung 339) ba chu/ snang ba brda'i rak+ta ni kha dog dmar po 'gyur tshad/ 'gyur med don gyi rak+ta ni sor rtog ye shes kyi bdag nyid snang ba mtha' yas/ 'khor ba rgyu'i rak+ta ni ma'i mngal khrag 'bras bu chen po'i rak+ta ni gdug pa ru tra bsgral ba'i snying khrag yin par bshad/ ༈ rak+ta'i ming gi nges tshig ni/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du rak+ta/ bod skad du ni kha dog gi skabs su ni dmar po la 'jug byed las kyi skabs su ni chags pa la 'jug dngos po'i skabs su ni khrag la 'jug pa ste/ skabs 'dir ni khrag la de thams cad tshang bar bshad do/ ༈ dbye ba'i rnam grangs ni/ rak+ta'i rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag gsum cu rtsa lnga*/ de'i yan lag ni grangs las 'das par bshad do/ de las rtsa ba brgyad ni/ yab kyi sna g.yas pa'i rak+ta/ yum gyi pad+ma'i rak+ta/ srid pa chags pa'i lte khrag g.yul 340) du bsad pa'i dpa' bo'i khrag ste nang gi rtsa ba bzhi dang*/ stag gzig sogs gcan gzan gyi khrag bya rgod sogs 'dab chags khrag g.yag sogs rmig khrag gi khrag ste phyi'i rtsa ba bzhi po bsdoms pas rak+ta'i rtsa ba brgyad do/ ༈ yan lag sum cu rtsa lnga las/ mtshal/ li khri/ btsag lhong ros/ rdo rje dreg ste sa'i rak+ta lnga*/ tsan dan dmar po/ seng ldeng*/ mdzo mo shing*/ gor+shi ṣa/ shir shing dmar po ste shing gi rak+ta lnga 1$0000180'di gnyis ma rnyed na/ ltar bu dang kaṇ+ṭa kā ri dmar po la rung bar bshad/ 1$0000250pad+ma rā ga byu ru/ mchong dmar/ me shel/ rdo rgyus dmar po/ sbal rgyab gang rung ste/ me tog gi shing rak+ta lnga*/ ra mo shag

nye shing sa snya lo/ gro ma/ nyung ma/ 1$10001801$0000180'di'i dngos de ni mdo khams klong thang sogs su skye ba'i khrag nyung zhes pa de'o/ 1$10002501$0000250dmar po ste/ rtsa ba'i 341) rak+ta lnga*/ rgun 'brum/ ram bu/ kha sran bre'o/ ba mkhal smug po/ kyu ru ra ste/ 'bras bu'i rak+ta lnga*/ rgya skyegs/ sin+dhu ra/ 'bri mog bu ram/ brag zhun te rtsi'i rak+ta lnga rnams dril bas rak+ta sum cu rtsa lnga po ni gtso bo lta bu yin la/ de'i yan lag tu ni/ rja sa sogs sa dmar gyi rigs su gyur tshad dang*/ rin chen nam dang zangs sogs rdo rigs dmar po thams cad/ ut+pal dmar po dang shang dril dmar po sogs me tog dmar po sogs thams cad tsong dmar dang sa 1$10001801$0000180'bri ta sa 'dzin gzir/1$1000180 'dres sogs rtsa ba dmar ba'i dmar ba'i rigs thams cad/ 1$0000180dbyi mong*/1$1000180 sna ma'i 'bras bu dang 'ol ma si sogs 'bras bu dmar po thams cad/ 'bras dmar dang khre dmar sogs 'bras bu'i rigs dmar po thams cad/ ༈ de ltar rak+ta'i rnam grangs spyir bstan nas/ 342) skabs 'di'i dgos don snying po mdor bsdus te bshad pa ni/ ma hā rak+ta/ nu he rak+ta dang gsum gsang sngags bla med kyi chog gzhung phal cher du 'byung phyir/ de las dang po ma hā ni gdug pa can bsgral ba'i khrag chen 'jug cing*/ da lta na dmigs rten tsam du srog chags g.yag dang ra sogs kyi khrag gtsang mas rung la/ ༈ gnyis pa mū la rak+ta ni snod bcud chags pa'i rgyu'i rtsa ba la 'jug phyir/ chu gtsang ma la gong du brjod pa'i sman rdzas dmar po'i rigs rnams ci 'dzoms su btab pas rung ba dang*/ ༈ gsum pa gu h+ya rak+ta ni mtshan ldan grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa'i pad raka la 'jug kyang*/ ma rnyed pa'am gang zag gi blor ma shong 1$0000180sin+dhu ra dang*/1$1000180 na rak+ta byin rlabs kyi skabs su lha mo rdo rje sgeg mo bskyed pa'i gsang ba nas rak+ta'i rgyun
343) babs pa sogs dam tshig gi rak+ta'i rgya mtsho la ye shes kyi rak+ta'i char rgyun phabs cing bstim pa de kas chog pa ste/ mdor na rak+ta'i mchod pa dngos su bshams zhing 'bul rgyu ni 'dir 'du la/

yang pad+ma maṃ sar sbyar ba'i rak+ta dang zhes sogs chog gzhung las gsungs ba'i don ni thugs dam bskang rdzas kyi rnam grangs brjod pa ste/ pad+ma'i snod ni thod pa/ maṃ sa ni dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang po lnga dang don snying sogs dang*/ rak+ta ni de'i snying khrag sogs la 'jug pa dang*/ yang dug gsum rtsad gcod kyi mchod pa la gti mug sha'i phung po/ 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho/ zhe sdang rus pa'i ri rab sogs gsungs pa ni/ ngo bo nyon mongs pa dug gsum po/ rnam pa dgra gegs kyi sha khrag rus khrag rus gsum gyis mchod pas/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbyings su sbyor ba'i thabs dang*/ yang rten 'brel bcu gnyis mū la rak+ta zhes 344)gsungs pa'i mū la ni rtsa ba'i skad dod yin phyir/ 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ bcu gnyis po'i rtsa ba ni ma rig pa la 'dug pas/ ma rig pa rtsad nas chod pa ni rig pa ye shes/ rig pa'i ye shes rang ngo shes shing mngon du gyur ba ni 'khor ba'i sa bon bcom pa yin don gyis/ rgyu drug 'khor ba bsgral ba'i rak+ta ces kyang gsungs so/ gzhan yang*/ gnas skabs su lha dang chos srung ma mgon pho rgyud mo rgyud so so la rang gi dam rdzas dang bskang rdzas kyi bye brag tha dad pa dgos pa'i rigs ni mtha' yas te/ dpa' bo'i snying khrag nal bu'i khrag rta nag g.yag lug rwa/ bya dkar dang mtshal bu dang bya nag gi rigs kyi khrag sogs skabs kyi dgos don tha dad pa'i dmigs gsal dag ni rang rang gi sgrub thabs dang chog gzhung so so las 'byung phyir/ 'dir smos mi 'tshal lags kyi/ 345) ༈ 'on kyang 'gag don du dri ba'i snying po ni/ gsang sngags bla med nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni lta ba'i gdengs kyis 'khor 'das sems su thag chod pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snang srid dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba/ brtul zhugs kyi rtsal gyis gang byung lam du lhongs pa gcig mod kyang*/

deng sang ni de lta bu dkon te/ ji skad du/ gsang sngags pa la rab 'bring mtha' gsum yod pa'i sngags pa rab la shar ba rnam pa lnga 'byung ba ni/ sems can sangs rgyas su shar bas snang ba sna tshogs chos nyid du 'khyer shes/ nyon mongs ye shes su shar bas spang blangs 'gag sgrub rang sar grol ba'i gnad shes/ rnam rtog chos nyid du shar bas chos sku rang la ye nas gnas pa'i 346) don shes pa ste/ de ltar shar ba lnga dang ldan pa ni ding sang mi rnyed/ yang sngags pa 'bring la gsal ba rnam pa lnga ste/ stong gsum lha'i gzhal yas su gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor la che chung yang dog med pa/ phung khams lha ru gsal bas bar chad gdon bgegs kyi yul dang bral/ snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod du gsal bas gtor mchod la bzang ngan gyi mtshan 'dzin med/ snang srid thams cad dam rdzas su gsal bas srung ma dam can mi dgyes pa'am ma skongs pa'i skyon zad/ gnas lugs stong pa nyid du gsal bas sangs rgyas kyi chos ma lus rang sems la rdzogs pa ste/ de lta bu ldan pa yang ding sang rnyed par dka' bas/ da lta'i gsang sngags par rlom pa phal cher ni bzung ba rnam pa lngas bcings pa shas che ste/ bskyed rim rtag brtan ther zug tu bzung bas lha 'grub pa'i dus med/ phrin las 347) gyer la sgom med du bzung bas gsang sngags dam med lto phyir bon gyer du song*/ sngags dang snying po rang rgyud par bzung bas byin rlabs dang nus pa'i rgyu med/ rdzas dang gtor chung bshos bur bzung zhing za 'dod dang brnab sems kyi 'bras bus dkor dang rnam smin gyi 'dam du chud/ 'bras bu 'jig rten rtag chad du bzung bas ru tra'i gol sar lta bur 'gyur gyi gsang sngags pa mang bar gda' bas/ ༈ des na dam rdzas sman rag gi rgyu dang dngos po yang gzhung ci lta ba'i tshul ldan ni gdams ngag gi spyod yul du ma gyur tshe/ bdag gis ni/ bdud rtsi'i rtsa ba brgyad kyang phyi'i brgyad po dngos su sbyar zhing*/

357) cing stabs pa der/ de ltar phyag bzhes 'di ni da lta snyim phu bya khyung sogs dgongs 'dus kyi bdag po rnams ji lta bar mdzad pa 'di lugs gcig yang*/ bsgrub pa bka' brgyad chen mo gter kha gong 'og sogs ltar na/ tshogs byin gyis brlab ma thag spros nas phud dang po dkyil 'khor du 'bul zhing de shul snod tha dad par bshams pas/ dang po thugs dam bskangs/ bar pa nyams bshags/ tha mas bsgral stabs bya ba ste tshogs phud rim pa gsum/ de shul bar pa ni sgrub pa po rnams dngos grub tu rol/ mthar lhag ma yang yar gnas dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang*/ mar gnas bka' sdod pho nya yang g.yog dang bcas la 'bul rgyu'i rim pa so sor gsungs pa dang*/ 'di la'ang nang gses kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par yod de/ bka' brgyad bskyed 358) rdzogs che 'bring rnams su ni/ phud dang po g.yas zhal dkar po chos kyi sku la mchod/ bar pa de la dgug bstim bsgral las byas nas dbus zhal mthing ga sprul pa sku la bstab/ rjes ma des g.yon zhal dmar po longs sku la nyams chags bshad pa ste/ 'di'i lugs gcig yang bskyed rdzogs chung du ni tshogs byin rlabs byas nas spros te/ phud dang po gtor ma'am dkyil 'khor drung du phul ba des mchod bshags bskang ba rnams gcig car du byas la/ phud bar pa ni dkyil 'khor du tshur spyan ma 'drongs pa'i mgron rigs gong 'og bar ma kun la phyi rol nam mkha' mthong par gnam phud du 'thor/ tha ma des bsgral stabs byas nas/ 359) sgrub pa po rnams tshogs la rol rjes lhag ma'i mgron rnams la lhag gtor bsngo ba'i sgrig rim 'di lugs gcig yin pas/ gtor gsar gyi las gzhung 'di dag tu yang 'di dag tu yang 'di dang mthun par mdzad pa lags shing*/ gang ltar yang*/ tshogs lhag ni 'chad mdo gtor zor 'phangs pa sogs kyi sngon du bya bar gsungs pa ni gter kha gong 'og rgyas bsdus phal cher mthun pa dang*/

bka' gsar rnying*/ rgyud sde gong 'og sogs gcig la yod pa de thams cad la dgongs nges dang*/ la lar med pa gzhan la yod pa yang 'dor dgos pa lta bu ma yin tshe/ rgyud 'brel tha dad dang paṇa grub so so'i phyag bzhes bzhin byed dgos phyir/ 364) rnying lugs la gu ru rin po che'i gter gzhung nyid ji lta ba ma gtogs gzhan dang bstun dgos pa ma yin mod kyi/ ༈ gter gsar 'dir yang dkon mchog spyi 'dus nyid cung zad bsdus pa'i gshis kyis/ rmad las dgra gegs sgrol phyir skor sogs rgyas par mgon po ma ning gi chos skor du bstan zhing*/ nyer mkho 'ga' zhig ni zhi khro nges don snying po dang bsdebs rgyur snang na'ang*/ gter ston chen po de nyid kyi 'gro don thog mar mdzad skabs zhi khro dang mgon po sogs zhal ma phyes pa'i gshis kyi gter rnying bka' brgyad sogs dgongs 'dus sogs nas 'gebs par mdzad dgos byung ba dang*/ de dag kyang dus gcig la ma yin par dgos ched dang zhu ba po sogs kyi stabs las phral phral du sdebs pa gnang gshis kyis cho ga'i sgrigs rim tshad gcig tu med par thar thor du gyur pa lta bu 365) 'di lags mod kyang byin rlabs kyi babs ni dman par 'byung ste/ de thams cad gu ru'i bka' dri ma med pa sha stag yin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ 'di skabs 'phros don du de khar sngar gyi phyag bzhes su tshogs lhag ni thams cad kyi rjes su mdzad tshul sogs la mi 'thad pa'i klan ka sna tshogs zer zhing*/ dkyil 'khor sa thams cad dgra phyogs su rbad bskul gyis gshegs tshar nas shul du lhag gtor su la 'bul/ zhes sogs kyi ngag 'khyal sgrog par byed pa dag ni gsang sngags lta sgom ting 'dzin gnad don yid la 'khor ma myong ba'i rang 'tshang ston pa'i gtam du zad de/ zer tshul de ltar na lha tshogs rnams dgra phyogs su byon nas slar tshur byon rgyu ye med pa lta bur 'dod dgos phyir/

sgrub pa po rnams nang du log dus rjes chog gi dngos grub blangs ba dang nyes byas bshags pa sogs kyang su la 366) byed zer dgos par 'gyur zhing*/ bsnga smon bkra shis sogs byed pa'i dpang po yang med pas byas kyang dom med do zer ram/ 'di lta bu ni spyod ldan rnams 'khrel gad kyi rgyur 'gyur ba nyid las 'do ci zhig ༈ de bas na dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad don dam chos dbyings kun tu bzang po spros bral thig le nyag gcig las rdul tsam g.yos pa med kyang*/ gnas skabs gdul bya'i yul dang 'tshams pa'i rdzu 'phrul sprul sgyur gyi zlos gar ni 'jig rten khams rgya mtsho ji snyed par khengs zhing phrin las rab 'byams mtha' yas pa se gol gyi yun tsam rdzogs par ston kyang ngo bo la 'pho 'argyur 'gro 'ong bya byed sogs kyi rtsom rtog dang 'jig pa ni skrag nyag brgyar bshags pa'i cha tsam yang ga la mchis te/ zhing dang dngos por snang yang dngos por ma grub/ sku ltar snang yang mtshan mar ma grub/ mdzad phrin ltar snang yang gzugs brnyan du gzugs brnyan 367) du ma grub pa'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rol pa 'ba' shig las gzhan ma yin tshe/ thugs rje'i rnam rol mtha' yas par spro/ bsdu/ gshegs/ bzhugs/ ci dang ci lta bur bstan kyang chos sku'i klong las skad cig kyang ma 'das te/ ji ltar nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin gyi tshong ji snyed shar/ 'phros/ dengs/ thim pa sogs ci ltar byas kyang nam mkha'i las g.yos pa med pa bzhin/ rgyal ba'i mdzad phrin dang rnal 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spro bsdu rnams kyang de dang mtshungs par shes dgos pa nyid de/ ji skad du/ 'bras bu gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud las/ sku dang ye shes zhing khams la// 'du ba'i phrin las thams cad ni// snga phyi bye brag tha dad med// thams cad bde chen lhan cig skyes// nyi ma'i 'od dang snang byed bzhin// ye shes snang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sangs rgyas thog mtha' med pa kun// ye shes snang ba gcig la spyod// zhes sogs

368) dang*/ sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo las kyang*/ thugs rje ngang gi sprul pa ni// gang yin gtso bo dbyer med pa'i// sprul pa dpag 'gyed pa yis// snang srid 'jig rten thams cad gang*// so so'i phrin las sna tshogs byed// yang ni so so'i dbyings su thim// de bzhin gcig las gcig sprul zhing*/ /mar me gcig las gcig 'phel bas// thams cad mar mes gang ba ltar// sdong po gcig las yal ga 'bum// so sor dgyes pa lta bur sprul// de dag gdul bya'i snang tshul te// zla ba dang ni chu snod bzhin/ /gcig las mang po sprul snang ba'o// zhes pa de lta bu'i dgongs don ma gtogs na gsang sngags zab mo'i chos tshul la 'jug pa'i thabs mi 'byung zhing*/ chos kyi dbyings zab mo blo khog tu mi shong bzhin theg chen gsang sngags par khas blangs nas/ dgos gal che ba'i don gyi snying po rang gi rgyud la ma 'byor bar/ gzhan la tshig sho lo ka re gnyis kyi snga rting tsam la'ang sgro btags kyi skyon 'gel byas te/ 'di ni mthos so/ 'di ni dmas so/ 'di ni nor ro/ 'di ni 'khrul lo zhes smra bar byed pa ni rang nyid ngan 'gro'i rgyu sgrub pa tsam las gzhan pa'i dgos pa ci yang mi 'byung gi de bas kyang dang por gong du smos pa'i gnas lugs ye ji bzhin pa'i yin tshul 'di+u thugs la shong shing nges pa gcig mdzod dang*/ tshig brjod snga phyi phran tshegs kyi rim pa la rag ma lus pa'i don zhig 'grub nas 'ong gi ༈ ji skad du/ rang rig rtsal gyis yongs la ma gdal na// phral gyi 'phro 'dus nyon mongs dngas mi 'gyur skad cig tsam la rang byung nyid shar bas/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin ma bsgom gsal// zhes dang*/ dgongs pa yid kyi ting 'dzin ma gsal na// phral gyi spro bsdus rang rig lha mi gsal// chos nyid rang gsal rig pa'i gting rtogs na// ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul ma bsgoms gsal// zhes zhi khro don khris gsungs pa ltar gyi don rgyud la 'byor dgos pa lags/

zhes klan ka sgrog pa po la gdams so/ ༈ rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mchog gi sprul ba'i sku'i// bka' mched lan du ci nus phul ba yi// zhar byung gzhan gyi ngag 'khyal zlog tshig 'di// mi rgan shi skra dkar po'i khebs bzhin du// dal gtam yi ger 'god pa'i long med kyang*// dang po'i las can blo dman dad ldan dag yid kyi 'ching ba gcod la phan nam snyam// smras 'di nyes pa'i rgyu ru ma gyur cig shu bhaṃ/ ༈ yang re bka'i glegs bu rin po che bstsal ba'i khrod na/ gter gsar gyi chos bka' tha dad pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi 371) skabs don rnams smra bar byos shig ces gsungs pa'i char/ spyir yang rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon pa'i chos skor 'di dag pha mo che'i babs yul ni rnying lugs las kyang gsar ma lugs kho na 'dra che ba zhig nges par snang ba ni bdag 'dra blun pos kyang ma mthong la/ gzhan gyis kyang de bzhin zer ba dang*/ khyad par rnying ma bar rlom pa rig 'dzin de nyid la mi mos pa dag gis skur zhus byed pa'i rgyu rkyen yang de 'dra'i stabs kyis yin par snang la/ rdzogs rim nges don lta sgom skabs kyi chos skad rnams la'ang ming rdzogs chen du btags kyang dngos gzhi phyag chen por bzhag tu 'dug ces snyad 'dogs byed mod kyi/ bdag 'dras bsam tshod la ni/ gu ru rin po che nyid 'khor 'das dus gsum gsal ler mkhyen 372) pas/ gter bton so so'i goms 'dris dang mthun pa'i chos bka' gtad pa ni shes par yod 'dug ste/ dper na mnga' bdag myang zhi byed la mkhas pa la zhi byed kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i chos skor mang du gtad/ gu ru chos dbangalasman rtsis la mkhas pas sman rtsis kyi skor mang du gnang*/ de bzhin du rgya zhang khrom mthu mkhan la mthu gtad kyi skor dang*/ bon po brag tshal dngabon gsas khyung 'thogs sogs la bon/ rang khrag gter bton mdos mkhan la mdos chog ra mo shel sman dang ku tsha sman pa sogs la sman dpyad kyi gter kha gtad pa dang*/

gzhan yang rin chen gling pa'i chos skor gyi bdag po rje rang byung gis mdzad dgos phyir phyag chen chos drug sogs byung ba dang*/ chos skad kyi babs 'gros kyang*/ mnga' ris 373) paṇa chen sa skya'i skor la mkhas pas gter chos kyi dbyibs kyang sa lugs 'dra ba dang*/ 'phrang po gter bton yang gsar ma mkhas phyir gter chos kyang gsar ma'i chos skad 'dra bar snang tshe/ rig 'dzin chen po 'di nyid kyang dang po'i chos sgor zhugs lugs dang bstun nas gnang ba zhig yin par nges tshe/ rnying ma'i chos skad 'dra po ma byung zhes 'khun pa dag ni rang nyid mthong rgya chung skyon las gzhan ma yin mod/ rang bzhin babs kyi don ni/ gter ston gter chos sogs kyi skor 'di la chos mig rdul bral ma thob ring la brtag dka' zhing*/ gal te bslus na ni phung tshabs kyang che phyir/ rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyang 'gro don mdzad nas rgyang tsam ma song gi bar du/ bdag cag kyang lkog 374) gyur gyi gnas mi shes tshe ha cang dag snang byed sngas sa la dga' rgyu mi 'ong zhing*/ lhag par rtogs ldan gyi rigs la bzang ngan sna tshogs shig mthong ba dang*/ gter bton de nyid kyang thog mar sman pa dang*/ de nas rtogs ldan slar gter bton du gyur tshe de 'dra ci yin mi shes ces gleng gzhi btang snyoms su gnas pa la/ slad du rje nor bu bdag rkyen mdzad par thos phral nas/ da ni the tshom mi dgos te/ rje de nyid ni spyir skyes chen rtsod bral yin par lta ci smos kyi/ sgos su gsar rnying gnyis kar mkhyen gzigs zla med dang*/ khyad par thugs dam mngon mkhyen gyis legs nyes sgrib bral du gzigs pas na rje des de ltar mdzad nas som nyi mi dgos zhes bgros te rig 'dzin de nyid spyan drangs pas/ rnying ma bar rlom pa'i u tshugs 375) can gyi/ bon rigs sogs mang po yang rtse le bas gter ston tshad ldan du mthong yod par 'dug pas skyabs su mchi zhes 'dus shing btud/

de ltar bdag cag gi 'bul gsol bkur bsti rgya can byed rgyu med rung*/ kong po/ spu bo/ khams dang 'jang yan chad kyi rnying ma'i gdul bya gtogs pa thams cad 'dus shing 'gro don cher rgyas byung song ba dang*/ 'jang sa thams cad rgyal po'i zhu yig 'bul ba sogs kyang sku zhabs su yar phul zhing*/ mar la phyag tham dam rdzas gter chos dad rten sogs gnang ba'i brda sbyor sogs kyang bdag gis phyag phyi zhus pa la mnyes tshor yang che bar mdzad pa byung lags pa sogs 'phros zhus su gsol ba dang*/ ༈ skabs don dngos la/ de yang bdag ni gter gsar dkon mchog spyi 'dus rtsa ba gsum la grangs 376) bsnyen lhag tsam dang*/ khyad par gu ru zhi bsnyen la 'bum khrag brgya dang nyer brgyad tsam dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i phyi sgrub skye bdun sgub pa dang sbrags pa la bye ba brgyad ma gtogs gtor rjes ma rnams so so'i sger bsnyen ma byas te/ rig 'dzin de nyid kyi bka' la/ khyod rang la bdag gis chos 'di thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur/ byin byis brlab/ bka' gtad/ lung phogs/ mnga' gsol ba 'di kas gzhan don byed dgos pa byung na ni ji ltar 'dod dgos pa gyis la/ khyod rang nyams len ni bstan pa'i babs kyi rten 'brel yin pas gter rnying rang la 'bungs shig ces pa'i zhal gdams yod par brten/ de nas bzung ste rang nyid kyang gcig car ba'i blor song gshis kyis/ jo bo chen pos lo chen rin bzang dang*/ zhang sna chung ston pa sogs la/ chos snying por bsdus la nyams su longs shig gsungs pa ltar bgyid khus kyis sna mang gi spros pa bskyungs pa'i khus lags shing*/ ci zhu na/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus la ni gzhung gi ma hā'i bskyed rim nas zhal gsal ba dang*/ de las spros pa che bar 'dod pa dag ni gter bton nyid kyid mdzad pa'i yang 'grel du yod pa ltar bsgom pas 'grub mod la/ ༈tshe sgrub gnam lcags rdo rje ni spyir chos kyi babs tshul pad gling tshe sgrub sogs dang mthun shas che ba dang*/

bsnyen sgrub kyi dmigs rim skor la lar grub rgyal ma sogs dang yang gcig shas che bas/ rje nyid lta bus mi dgongs rgyu ni ga la srid dang*/ de yang gdams ngag bskyed rdzogs la goms shing spros pa chung ba'i rigs ni rgyun 'khyer gnyis gang rung kho nas chog mod kyang*/ spros bcas la mos pa dang*/ khyad par chos 'di 378) kho na la mi tshe'i chos skal du byed mkhan lta bu yin na/ thog mar dbang lung rnams yongs rdzogs zhus lags/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi nyams len kha skongs la dgaso rigs thams cad ni bi ma la'i chos spyod ltar blo la nges par bya zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i bsnyen sgrub gtso bor phyi sgrub lha gcig dkar po la gzhung ji lta bar 'bad/ de nas rtsa rlung thig le'i nyams len sngar mi shes na bla mas zab lam gyi khrid tshul ldan btab cing*/ de dag gi gnad shes par gyur pa na tshe dpag med kyi nang sgrub rtags thon du 'bad de rjes gsang sgrub la 'bad nas de thams cad la goms pa thob na/ man ngag gsang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyi las tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi las sbyor de dag thams cad tshegs med du 'grub mod/ gal te gdams ngag snod ldan khyad par ba'i rigs 'og sgo bde chen gyi skal ldan yin 379)pa'i tshe na ni sngon la nang sgrub gsang sgrub rnams lhag par gnad bsnun rtags thon du byed dgos pa ni gal po cher gda' ba dang*/ mdor na 'di skabs kyi phyi nang gsang sgrub thams cad lus dkyil 'ba' shig yin phyir mtshan bcas kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas bshams mi dgos pa shas che ba dang*/ dmigs pa dang bzlas pa sngags sogs ni gzhung nyid nas shin tu zhib phyir slar zin ris sogs dgos pa'i rigs ma mchis la/ 'onakyang slob ma gsar bu ba la gnang ba'i skabs lta bur ni bskyed rdzogs kyi go bya bzhi nas ma dkrol na khong tshos mi go tsho spyi gzhung ltar khris dgos pa lags/

༈ thugs rje chen po la ni spyir gtor kha tha dad la thugs rje chen po'i chos skor yang rgyud sde gong 'og sna tshogs dang*/ phal cher ni bla med lugs shas che ba tsam byung na'ang*/ 'di 380) ni chos rgyal srong btsan lugs ding sang chos rgyud spyi la yongs grags 'di ka dang mthun pa nyid du gda' ba dang*/ 'di la dbang gi skabs sogs su bla med kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs mdor bsdus mdzad pa tsam las/ chos dka' dngos gzhi spyod rgyud kyi phyogs su gtogs par bzhard kyang*/ snang sris gzhi bzhengs kyi bskyed tshul dang*/ nang sgrub yum bcas sogs bla med dang mthun par gzhir bcas la/ rdzogs rim bye brag pa thabs lam sogs kyang bstan 'dug pa rnams kyis rgyud sde gong 'og thams cad kyi gnad don tshang bar gsal mod kyi/ 'di'i nyams len la/ thog mar sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor ni gtso bor khrid la bsngags pa yin mod kyang bskyed rim bsnyen sgrub kyi yang thun mgor yod na legs pa dang*/ dngos gzhi ni/ phyi sgrub phyag stong spyan stong de nyid ming phyi sgrub tu btags kyang don 381) la theg chen gsang sngags kyi sgom rim dkyil 'khor gsum ldan zab pa'i snying po yin par gda' bas/ dbang po rab kyi bsgom tshul 'di las lhag pa'i bskyed rdzogs gzhan dgos par ma gyur la/ 'di la 'khor tshogs bskyed pa ni cho ga dang dbang po sogs mdun bskyed bsgrub dgos na ma gtogs

bdag bskyed rgyun gyi nyams len la ni snang srid snod bcud thams cad 'phags pa nyid du byas tshe 'khor zur du bsgom dgos pa ma mchis la/ gzungs ring dang yig 'bru gang bzla yang dmigs pa ni gzhung nyid ltar gyis 'thus pa dang*/ 'di la 'bad nus na/ nang dang gsang ba de bzhin nyid sgrub sogs mthar chags su nges par dgos pa ni ma lags kyi/ gal te cis kyang thams cad tshang bar bsnyen 'dod pa lta bus ni sngon la phyi sgrub 'di lo zla zhag 382) ji tsam 'dod pa byas la/ de nas nang gsang rnams kyang zla re sogs spyi ltar 'dod pa byas pas rung ba dang*/ khyad par bka' tham du/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi spyan ras gzigs gsum po de sems dpa' gsum brtsegs ltar nang la nang bcug lta bur dgos mi dgos phebs pa de ni/ bdag gis rig 'dzin chen po la sger zhus bzhin ma byas kyang*/ rang gi go tshod la ni de gsum po rang nyid gang mos su gang rung gcig sgom pa ma gtogs dus gcig la gsum ga dgos par mi sems te/ tshe sgrub rgyun 'khyer gnyisadagongs pa gcig par go la/ dgos pa ni/ gdams ngag spros med dam long khyab med pa'i rigs la dgongs sam snyam ste/ gzhung nyid nas lha grangs gtso 'khor gang rung la khol 'don du sgrub kyang byin rlabs lhag par che ba ni sprul pa'i chos rgyal nyid kyi zhal lung yin 383) zhes gsungs 'dug pa'i phyir ro/ des na bskyed chog rgyas pa'i rim pa la mos na de'i yon tan mchod bstod sogs kyang gzhung nyid ltar byas la/ bsdus pa rgyun khyer ga la ni bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'khor yug yin phyir chu bo'i rgyun ltar ma gtogs brjod bya mang po gshegs bsdu sogs mi dgos pa ni dgongs mnga' ltar dang*/ 'di la yang dbang*/ rab gnas/ gshin don/ bum sgrub sogs las mtha' zur dgos yin na ma gtogs/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa gang la yang dkyil 'khor sogs mi dgos pa ni spyi dang mthun no/

gong zhus ltar/ chos longs sprul gsum gyi thegs rje chen po de dag nang la nang bcug tu dgos pa zhig yin na ni phyi nang gi go rim yang go log lta bur 'gyur bar snang ste/ dper na bka' brgyad dngos grub snying por phyi sprul sku'i che chog dbu mang phyag mang rnams kyi nang du rim pas zhal phyag nyung du bsdus nas/ mthar thugs ka'i chos sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa snying po'i he ru kar mdzad pa ltar/ 'dir yang de lta bur dgos par sems kyang de dang ma gcig par phyi nang go ldog tu snang bas des na bdag ni 'di dag tha dad gang mos su bsgom rgyu kho nar brtsi ba lags/ ༈ snyan brgyud gtsug rgyan nor bu'i rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ khar+sa pā ṇi bskyed tshul gzhung bzhin la/ bzlas pa'i skabs su yi ge bcu pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hriḥ.om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa nyid yin pa dang*/ bsnyen tshad bye ba'am gang 'grub song ba dang*/ bla ma sku gsum rnams kyang bsnyen tshad zhag grangs sogs mos blo dang bstun zhing*/ 'jigs byed nag po ni ched du drag las bsgrub dgos pa'am/ khyad par byad ma nang 'dras lta bu zlog pa gzhan gyis mi bzlog 385) pa'i rigs la 'di nyid bsngags pa yin zhes rig 'dzin chen po de nyid gsungs pa las/ rgyun gyi nyams len dkyus mar dgos pa ni min par snang zhing*/ snyan brgyud nyid kyi rgyun khyer ni/ mjug gi yig chung la 'khod par gnang ba rig 'dzin chen po nyid kyid nyams bzhes yin gsungs ba de skabs thugs kar rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam shes kyi tshul du gsal ba de rje btsun mi pham blo gros la mdzad mod kyi/ 'o skol gzhan rnams kyis ni rig 'dzin chen po nyid bsgom rgyu dang*/ 'khor yang 'dod bstun byas chog par gsungs pa bzhin/ gu ru rin po che/ srong btsan sgam po/ mnyam med rin po che rnams la mi mos mkhan mi 'byung la/ rgyal ba'i dbang po sogs kyi dod du rang rang gi bla ma gang yin bskyed par spro na de bzhin bya/

gzhan zhib cha mtha' dag gzhung nyid nas 'byung ba la ma 'thus pa med do/ 386) ༈ rta phag yid bzhin nor bu la// ltung bshags lha tshogs ni mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs yul du gsal rgyu lags shing*/ bsnyen sgrub dngos kyi dang por phyi sgrub ni khar+sa pa ṇi bskyed tshul gzhung bzhin dang*/ nang sgrub ni de gnyis rta mgrin du gnas bsgyur ba ste/ rta mgin 'di ni ngo bo la khyad ga la yod kyang gnas skabs kyi cha lugs rnam 'gyur ni sngon gter bton snye mo zhu yas kyi gter nas gdan drangs kyang 'gro don ma byung bar phyis skyer sgangapa chen po'i phyag tu babs shing*/ khong gis mnal lam bzung nas rnga yab gling du gu ru nyid la zhus shing spel bas/ ding sang shangs pa'i rta mgrin zhes yongs grags de dang gcig par gda' lags/ gsang sgrub bam rgyun khyer gyi nyams len ni/ hrīḥ bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum ni// zhes sogs gzhug las byung ba ltar gsal nas yi ge bcu gcig pa bzla ba 387) dang*/ 'di bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug thun mtshams bral ba chu bo rgyun gyi nyams len yin par gda' la/ gong gi phyi nang gi sgrub pa gnyis po sngon la ma thub pa'i tsha na'ang thog ma nas dril sgub 'di tshig dril du 'bad kyang chog par gsungs pa lags/ ༈ rdo rje khro lod la/ gu ru zhi ba sngon du sgrub cing yig bdun bsnyen tshul dang*/ slar khro lod nyid kyi hūm̐ sgrub dang bcas pa gzhung nyid kyi gsal mdo la/ bdag gi phul ba'i dbang chog 'dir yang zhib par bstan yod pas/ dbyings zab dam par bcags par gsol/ ༈ dpal mgon ma ning la ni/ spyir 'di rigs kyi sgrub pa po yang*/ rje de nyid lta bu la smos ci dgos kyi/ gdams ngag phal ba'i rigs la ni lta ba rgyab kyi lha dang gnyen po stobs kyi lha sogs la nus gdengs 388) tshad ldan sngon du 'gro dgos tshe/ snyigs dus kyi gdams ngag phral gyi 'dod thag nye la phugs kyi khe gyong mi shes pa mang phyir de 'dra'i rigs kyis bsgrub kyang gcer bu'i mda' kha dang*/

go med yul zhugs kyi dper zad mod kyi/ 'on kyang rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa tsam zhig byed pa'i dbang du bgyi na/ sngon la phyag rdor rta mgrin gang rung ngam/ rab la ni che mchog gi bsnyen pa bka' brgyad gter kha gang rung gi lugs ltar grangs bsnyen thems pa zhig ni med du mi rung dang*/ de nas 'di nyid la nam 'jug tshe gnas dben la mtshams dam pa dang*/ khyad par bud med kyi rigs kyis mi mthong bar/ mgon po'i sku rten bris 'bur ci rigs bshams pa'i drung du/ gtor ma bzang po gzi ldan rgyun bzhag zhig dang*/ nub re la 'bul rgyu'i gtor chung re/ 389) gzhan yang sman raka mchod tshogs spyan gzigs mgon rdzas gyi rigs gyi nam par bshams la/ skyabs sems bdun dag sogs thun mong gi sngon 'gro spyi mthun gyi rjes la/ bdag bskyed che mchog gi bskyed bzlas brgya stong gang rigs byas la/ de nas rang gi mdun du dur khrod thod mkhar me rlung 'tshub cing dreg byed sprin ltar 'thibs pa'i pho brang gi dbus suchos 'byung mthing nag pad nyi bam chen gyi gdan la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ mthing nag 'phros te gdan khar babs pa las 'od 'phros/ rgyal ba mchod cing 'gro sgrib sbyang ba dang gdug pa can tshar bcad nas 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pas gnas 'gyur te/ dpal mgon gyi cha lugs rdzogs par gsal ba'i g.yas 390) g.yon du gza' rdor gnyis/ mdun du las mkhan srog bdud dang bcas pa'i mtha' skor du sde brgyad sprul pa yang 'khor dang bcas pa nyi ma dang 'od ltar shugs 'byung du bskyedacing*/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros pas/ 'og min/ gsum rtsen/ ma la ya/ bsil ba tshal/ u tsa ma/ rdo rje gdan/ nā len+ḍa sogs bzhugs gnas rnams nas ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor bcas spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la dbyer med bstim/ bdag nyid che mchog gi phyag mtshan rdo rje mgon po'i spyi bor bzhag nas bka' bsgo dam bsgrags pas ci gsung sgrub par zhal gyis bzhes par mos shing bdag nyid bskyed rdzogs dbyer med kyi dpa' gdengs cher bskyed/

de nas mgon po'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags phreng kha dog nag la 391) gting mdangs dmar ba lcags bsreg gi 'khor lo lta bus bskor bar dmigs nas/ om̐ shrī ma hā kā la gha na gu h+ya ram sid+dhi hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzlas pa tsam gyis mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed kyang sbir ri ri bzla bar mdzad cing*/ bdag che mchog gi thugs srog hūm̐ gi 'od zer lnga ldan mgon po'i thugs srog la phog pas thugs dam rgyud bskul/ mgon po'i thugs srog las 'odamathing nag nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ gdug pa can mtha' dag brtul/ rgyal ba rab 'byams thugs rje nus stobs/ khams gsum sems can gyi tshe bsod bkrag mdangs longs spyod/ 'byung ba brtan g.yo mtha' dag gi bcud dwangs ma sogs bsdus nas mgon po'i thugs kar thim zhing*/ thugs ka nas slar yang 'od kyi tshul du nus bcud 392) de dag zad med du bdag gis thugs kar thim par bsam la/ mi tshig dang bya ba gzhan dang skad cig kyang ma 'dres par brtse gcig tu bsnyen/ nub re bzhin bskang gso tshogs mchod dang 'bul gtor ma chag par bya zhing*/ thun mthar mgon po'i 'khor rnams pho brang dang bcas pa gtso bo nyid la thim zhing*/ gtso bo nyid bdag la gnyis med du thim par dmigs pa dang*/ bdag bskyed ni mi bsdu bar lha'i nga rgyal dang 'bral med bya'o/ de lta bus zhag nyer gcig sogs kyis bsnyen pa ci mang dang*/ mtha' ma yang bye ba las mi nyung ba byas na cho 'phrul dang rtags kyi rnam grangs phran tshogs ci byung yang 'jigs sems dang zhen rlom spangs te rang sems kyi 'char tshul du thag bcad la 'khu 'phrig mi bya/ mthar thon pa'i nyin mo bskang gso tshogs 'khor 393) bshags bskongs rgyas pa dang*/ sgrub gtor de yang 'bul zhing phrin las bcol la ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa bdag la bslu/ bsngo smon shis brjod sogs ci ltar rgyas pa dang*/

rgyun par ngang dus bzang rnams su bskang gso gtor 'bul la brtson par bya'o/ de ltar rtsa bsnyen 'di tsam ni 'khu ldog chung zhing bkra shis/ mthu chen gos 'dod 'byung ba sogs gsungs la/ 'di las spros pa'i gzhung gi sgrub pa dngos rnams ni ding sang gi gang zag 'di dag sgrub pa po'i 'os su gyur kyang ches dkon la/ ci ste lan gcig 'grub kyang rgyun gyi dam tshig mchod gsol las sbyor sgrigs ma rnams kyang mtha' 'khyongs pa dka' zhing*/ de dag tshul bzhin ma byung na ni rang nyid la rang gshed 'beb pa'i rgyur zad pas na/ de las kyang 394) dang po nas rtsam pa khe che zhing*/ lhag par de khar ni mchog gi grub brnyes zam mchad par byon pa'i bka' drin las/ gri gug can dang trak+shad sogs grib ltar 'grogs pa yod bzhin du chos skyong sna mang ba la ya mtshan rgyu med pa ni/ dpal ldan 'brug pa'i mgon ma ning gi lo rgyus ngag sgros rnams ltar 'gyur bas na/ sngar gyi rnams la gsol mchod mi dman par mdzad par gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ yang gter gsar las 'phros pa'i skabs don zur gsal 'bul rgyur/ dgongs pa rin po ches chod pa gcig ga la mchis te/ zhi khro nges don gyi 'dzab tu phur pa rtsa sngags kyi skabs su/ spyir ni sgra pa lugs la/ sarba bi ghā naṃ zhes pa bgegs kyi dod yin te/ dper na las bum gyi lha bgegs mthar byed bskyed pa'i rtsa sngags kyang*/ om̐ āḥ bhi ga nam ta kṛta 395) hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces sogs byung mod cing*/ sa lugs kyi phur pa'i sngags kyang*/ sarba bi ghā naṃ ban+ha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces 'don pa'i srol yod par thos kyang*/ 'dir sger don rnying lugs por bzhag pa ni/ phur pa'i rgyud las sngags 'di nyid kyi sngags btu'i gzhung dpang por bzhag dgos phyir/ de las thog mar om̐ nyid kyi sgrub tshul yang*/ ji skad du/ thams cad kun gyi dang po la// dbyangs yig gnyis pas 'og tu brgyan// zhes pas/

a la ring po 'dogs lugs dang*// de la dbyangs kyi bcu drug pa'i// steng du thig le mdzes par bya// zhes pa na ro klad kor sbyar lugs bshad nas/ 'di ni ye shes lnga rdzogs te// sngags rnams kun gyi mgo ru bzhag /ces pas ā+oṃ de nas sa tshan gsum pa bzhag ba /de nas sa tshan gsum pa bzhag /ya tshan gnyis pas 'og 396) brgyan/ dz+ra ka tshan yi ge dang po bzhag /de la dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan// nyi ya tshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag de la dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan// li ka tshan yi ge dang po bzhag /de la dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan// ki ya mtshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag /la sha tshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag /sa ya mtshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag /de 'og sa tshan gsum pas spras// rba sa tshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag /de la dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan// de la ka tshan gsum par ldan// big ta tshan yi ge lnga gnyis ldan// nan sa tshan yi ge gsum pa bzhag /de la dbyangs kyi bco lngas brgyan/ baṃ sha tshan yi ge bzhi pa bzhag / de la dbyangs yig drug pas brgyan// steng nas thig les mdzes par brgyan// hūm̐/ sa tshan yi ge 397) gnyis pa bzhag /de dang ṭa tshan dang por ldan// phaṭaḥ ā+om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sarba big nan bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsang sngags yi ge bcu gcig pa// phur pa phrin las snying po ste// gtso 'khor bcas pa'i sngags su bshad// ces gsungs pa 'di bzhin rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum gyi phur ba'i rgyud gzhan las 'di kho na ltar gsungs pa dang*/ 'on kyang 'di la dpon slob gong ra lo chen gyi gsungs sgros su/ 'di'i ki gnyis ring por bya dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ni/ kī li kī li ya zhes phur bu la 'jug cing*/ kī li kī la ya zhes ring po med pa ni ca co'i sgra la 'jug pa yin phyir/ 'dir ring po thob pa yin zhes sgra pa lugs dang mthun par mdzad par snang la/ bi ghā naṃ ni bgegs la 'jug mod kyi/ 'dir ni bi big+nan zhes gzir ba'i don yin par gsungs pa dang*/

ban+dha dang baṃ gnyis 398) ka 'ching ba'i don yin kyang 'dir bshad pa'i sngags btur bam̐ nyid du gsungs pa ste yig 'bru'i grangs kyang*/ gsang sngags yi ge bcu bzhi pa ces pas/ om̐ ma rtsis pa'i yig 'bru bcu po la ngos 'dzin pa lags tshe/ des na bigh+na zhes sogs rnying lugs sger don gyi khyad par yin pa yang zab dbyings dam par bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs so/ 399) ༄༅/ nges don phyag rgya chen po'i phyogs nas dri ba la lan du bgyis pa yid bzhin nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 400) na 1$10001801$0000180rang sems gdod ma'i sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/1$1000180 1$10002501$0000250mas+s+wa tsit+ta di bud+dha ya/ gdod nas dag pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku mchog dri bral sangs rgyas dngos// rang byung rang zhal rang la gsal mdzad don rgyud byin rlabs gte mnga' ba'i// mnyam med drin can bla ma mchog nyid rang rig dbyer med rtag bzhugs la// 'du 'bral med pa'i phyag gi mchod do mchog dngos bde slag grub mdzad gsol// zhes mchod par brjod pa sngon du btang nas/ skabs 'dir seng gtam rgyal ba'i yang dben gyi sgrub grwa chen po nas 401) lung rtogs yon tan mtha' dag gis 'byor pa mi dman pa'i ston sgom smon lam sa'i mtshan 'chang ba gang des/ chos kun rnying po'i mthar thug nges don phyag rgya chen po'i phyogs nas dri ba'i yi ge rnam dpyod kyi dpal du 'bar ba lha rdzas kyi rten dang bcas te/ rgod tshang gi dben gnas su gnang bar mdzad pa ni ngo mtshar che mod kyang*/ spyir rgyal ba'i bka'i dgongs don ji bzhin pa dang*/ khyad par nges don zab mo'i legs bshad dri ma med pa ni dge ba'i gshes gnyen chen po mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa 402) rnams kyi zhal las 'byung phyir/ de lta bu rnams la 'dri bar mdzad par 'od mod kyi/ bdag 'dra ba'i rigs ni thog ma nas skyes thob kyi shes rab dang ni ma ldan cing thos bsam sgom pa'i sbyangs 'bras kyis phongs pa dang*/

chos kyi bsod nams dman pa'i las 'bras kyi rang gzugs zhig la grwa 'khor gyis sku skye ma bla mar ming du btags nas/ bsngo ba dang zachog tsam gyi slob gnyer la chog par bzung zhing dad zas gshin skor gyi rin du sprod rgyu'i bla gzugs ltar bcos pa'i ngang la dal 'byor gyi lang tsho cher 'das shing*/ ding sang kyang snod bcud dang gzhan gyi ngang tshul la yid yid skyo ba tsam gyi rkyen la brten nas dben khrod 'di dag tu mchis shing bde dal du gnas pa tsam las/ nyams rtogs yon tan gyi nor dang mi ldan phyir dri ba'i 1$1000250lan tshul bzhin du 'bul ba'i nus stobs ni cung zad kyang ga la mchis te/ 'on kyang rnam 'dren dam 403) lnga phrag gsum tsam gyi thugs rjes bskyangs pa'i gsung rgyun dag ji ltar thos pa dang dran pa'i cha shas tsam la brten pa'i lan gyi rnam pa sa bon tsam zhig 'bul bar bgyi na/ de la thog mar nyid kyi dri yig gi nang tshan du/ zhi gnas kyi skabs su/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gzhi gnas gnyis su phye ba ji ltar yin/ ces gsungs 'dug par/ de la spyir 'khor ba dang myang 'das gang du yang ma phye ba'i sngon rol na/ snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya la srid tshad kyi chos thams cad rang gi ngo bos stong zhing ma skye mi 'gag spros pa thams cad las 'das pa'i dbyings don dam pa'i gnas lugs sam/ bzhugs tshul lam/

yin tshul ji bzhin pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gzhi'i gnas lugs de la blo bur gyi 'khrul pa'i lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa ma shar bar rang rig yin lugs kyi thog tu 404) rang ngo shes pa la ni/ gsang sngags rnyigs ma'i skabs tshor/ ngo bo ka nas dag pa'am kun tu bzang po zhig thog tu grol ba zhes zer la/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang skabs su/ gnas lugs phyag chen du ming btags mod lags shing*/ de'i rang bzhin la ma rtogs par rang gi grib mas rang nyid bsgrib pa ltar/ lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa gser la g.ya' skyes pa bzhin du byung ste 'khrul ba'i sa bon rim can du 'phel ba'i dbang gis sems can rnams 'khor bar 'khyams shing*/ de ltar 'khrul 'khyams gyur pa'i skabs na yang gzhi'i ngo bo la 'gyur ba med pa'i dbang gis 'khrul ba ldog tu btub cing*/ bla ma dang gdams ngag brtson 'grus gsum 'dzoms na grol ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dpal 'phreng gi mdor/ bde bshegs snying po 'gro ba yongs la khyab// ces sogs dang*/ rtag gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 405) 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// ces dang*/ rgyud bla mar/ sangs rgyas sad ngan sogs kyi dpe dgu gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas lung dpag med mchis shing*/ 'di la rdzogs chen du ni rang bzhin lhun grub dang thugs rje kun khyab sogs kyi rgyas bshad dang*/ phyag chen rang las ni 'khrul lugs phyag rgya chen po sogs ming du btags pa mdzad phyir/ mdor na gzhi lam 'bras gsum gtan la 'bebs tshul ni chos lugs thams cad mthun cing*/ gzhi lam 'bras mngon du byed pa lam gal che ba dang*/ lam nyid la'ang theg pa'i bye brag mtha' yas kyang mdor bsdus tshe mdo sngags gnyis dang*/ de la yang myur zab sogs khyad chos mang po'i sgo nas sngags kho na dang*/ sngags nyid la'ang 'jug sgo smin grol gnyis las/

smin byed rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa'i sgo nas dbang don ngo 'phrod pa gal che ba dang*/ dbang gi 406) ye shes de ka nan chags su bya ba'i grol byed la yang bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ mchog tu gces pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa'i nang nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa/ grub thob thams cad kyi gzhung lam bla na med pa'i ngos gzhi phyag rgya chen po'i skabs 'dir/ zhi lhag gnyis kyi sgo nas gdams ngag rim gyis pa gtso bor 'jug thabs bstan pa dang*/ sbyangs pa mngon gyur dang gcig car ba'i rigs can 'ga' zhig ni rim can du dkri dgos te/ skyobs pa rin po ches kyang*/ chos dang dngos gzhi kyang sngon 'gro zab/ ces gsungs ba bzhin sngon 'gro'i bye brag rnams dal nan chags rtags thon du gal che ba dang*/ khyad par zhi gnas kyi skabs 407) 'dir 'jig rten las 'das zhi gnas gnyis su los kyang phye ste/ ci'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'gro ba dang mi 'gro ba'i khyad par yod pas so/ de nas zhi gnas tsam du ming gcig kyang don la khyad par che ste/ 'jig rten pa'i zhi gnas srid rtse bsgrubs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rigs ni mu stegs pa rnams la yang shin tu brtan par yod cing*/ de la brten nas ltar snang gi rdzu 'phrul mngon shes sogs phul du phyin pa mchis kyang*/ byang chub kyi rgyur til 'bru tsam yang ga la 'gro zhing*/ lha rnams la'ang skye mched mu bzhi man chad thams cad la so sor bsam gtan la brtan pa thob na'ang*/ yid dpyod kyi bsam gtan dang bde gsal mi rtog gsum gang rung la zhen 'dzin dang bcas phyir ting nge 'dzin la bskal pa mang por gnas kyang*/ nyon mongs bag la nyal gyi rtsa ba ma spongs phyir slar 408) rnam dkar gyi las 'bras zad pa dang ltung bar 'gyur la/ de dag las cung zad 'phags pa'i nyan rang gi bdag med bsgom pa sogs kyang mthar 'dzin nam yid dpyod dang lung ma bstan du 'gog pa'i rig sogs kyi sgrib cing phyogs re rtogs pa tsam sogs mdor na sngags phyi pa man chad rang rang gi grub mtha'i phyogs re'i lta ba kho nas bcings pas/

lhan skyes bcos min gyi ye shes dngos ma rtogs pas lam ring ba dang*/ sngags nang pa'am khyad par phyag chen gyi skabs 'dir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas sam mchog gi zhi gnas kho na ma gtogs gzhan gyis mi rung bar gsungs mod/ de ci zhe na/ 'jig rten pa'am dman pa'i zhi gnas kyis ni 'khor ba'am mngon mtho tsam 'grub pa'i thabs yin la/ de bsgrubs pas ni myang 'das dang nges legs mi 'grub pa'i phyir na/ 'dir 'jig rten las 409) 'das pa'i zhi gnas sam mchog gi zhi gnas kho na bsgrub dgos dang*/ de nyid kyang lhag mthong gi ma zin na zhi gnas kyi sgo ji ltar bzang kyang phyag rgya chen po'i sgom dngos gzhir go mi chod pa ni skyes chen thams cad bzhed pa mthun mod cing*/ de la mtshan bcas kyi zhi gnas rnams kyi thog mar sems 'dzin thabs dang*/ de nas mtshan med kyi gzhi gnas dngos la 'jug cing bsgom med yengs med kyi ngang la mnyam rtags 'char lugs tha dad 'byung mod kyi/ spyi khyab tu ni gnas sa dang po rnam rtog gang skyed dngos zin sa ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu dang*/ de nas rnam rtog rtag pa rag pa mgo non zhing rkyen snang phra mos mi gnod 410) pa'i gnas pa nyams bar ma chu bo dal 'bab kyang*/ de nas shin tu brtan cing nyin mtshan dang skyid sdug legs nyes sogs kyi bar du chod mi dgos par gnas nyams khor yug tu 'gro ba rgya mtsho g.yo med lta bu'i zhi gnas rnams 'char zhing*/ de tsa na zag bcas kyi mngon par shes pa sogs yon tan ltar snang ba'i rigs kyang ma bu 'byung bar gsungs mod kyi/ rnying rus dang mos gus zhen log sogs mi ldan par zhu lo dang sgom lo tsam gyi gdams ngag la ni lam rtags ni gdams ngag la ni rtags rnams tshul bzhin 'char ba nam yang mi 'byung lags mod/ ༈ yang*/ nyid kyi dri yig tu lung 'dren dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ dngos gzhi dran pa 'di la rtsol byas kyi dran pa dang rtsol med kyi dran pa nyis sa phye ba ji ltar yin gsung 'dug par/

de ni nyams len goms stobs che chung gi khyad par yin mod kyi/ de yang nyams len gyi skabs su 411) gong du brjod ltar/ sems gnas cha gtso bor bton pa'i dran pa brkyangs thabs la zhi gnas dang*/ gnas dang 'gyu 'phro gag byung cir snang lam du slong thabs kyi dran pa la lhag mthong du btags shing*/ 'di thabs rnying lugs rdzogs chen sogs su nyams len bskyangs thabs ring du ma zhig mchis kyang*/ ding sang gsar ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo che ba'i dgongs par ldan pa dka' bar gyur pa'i gshis kyis 'dir ma brjod la/ phyag rdzogs dbyer med kyi dgongs pa mngon du mdzad pa kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs dang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pa sogs kyi bka' 'bum na gzigs pas mthus shing*/ skabs 'dir phyag chen rang gzhung ltar/ sgom gyi dngos gzhi dran pa kho na la mdzad pa'i tshul ltar brjod na/ spyir dran pa zhes pa'i ming tsam 412) btags pa la ni rnam pa mang kyang*/ 'di skabs su ni rang rig gi dran pa'am/ yang dag gi dran pa kho na dgos la/ de la'ang las dang po pas ni mnyam gzhag gi tshe dmigs bcas kyi bsgom rgyu'am rgyu gang yang med par sems 'phro gnas bde bsal mi rtog sogs ci dang ci ltar 'char ba dang*/ snang ba sna tshogs dang tshogs drug gi bye brag gang snang ci shar thams cad la de'i rjes su yang mi 'breng*/ dgag kyang mi 'gag brtag dpyad kyang mi bya bar rang rig rang gsal 'dzin med kyi ngang du glod cing*/ tshor ba 'gags pa'am lung ma bstan du mi 'byams par gang bar ngo shes su byed pa la dran pa zhes btags la/ de nyid rjes thob tu yang lam du 'khyer zhing*/ mdor na bsgom rgyu spu tsam yang mi bya la/ tha mal 'khrul 'dzin zhen rtog gi dbang du skad cig kyang ma song bar byed pa la phyag rgya chen po zhes btags mod kyi/ 413)gang shar ma dran rig gis ngos zin pa'i nyams len 'di ni phyag chen gcig pur ma zad chos lugs thams cad kyi rdzogs rim dri ma med pa kun dgongs bzhed gcig tu mthun pa lags shing*/

dran rig de las lhag pa'i sgom bzang bzang ba zhig 'dod pa thams cad ni bcos ma dang zhe 'dod yid byed blos byas kyi sgom kho na yin phyir phyag chen du mi 'gro ste/ ji skad du lha mo bzhis zhus pa'i mdo las/ thub pa chen po'i chos rnams kyi// phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong la// gang gi de nyid mi shes pa// de dag thams cad 'bras bu med// ces dang*/ zhi ba lhas/ sems kyi gsang 'di ma rig na// bde 'dod sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyang*// bde ba 'dod pa tsam gyis las// de ni ngal ba kho nar zad// ces gsungs pa ltar/ gang shar dran pa'i rig pa tsam lasalhag pa 414) mi dgos pa dang*/ de nyid chos chams cad kyi snying po yin pa'i tshul yang*/ rje rang byung pas/ yid byed bral ba 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu ma chen po yin// 'di ni kun 'dus rdzogs chen zhes kyang bya// gcig shes kun don rtog pa'i gdengs thob shog /ces gsungs so/ de na las dang po pas gang shar thams cad la 'dzin med dran pas skyong ba kho na la sgom gyi mthil du bya zhing*/ 'di nyid re zhig la rtsol byas kyi dran pa lta bu yin rung*/ gzhan gyi zhe 'dod dang bcos mas ma slad par nyams su blangs na/ myur du stsol med kyi dran par 'gyur bar gsungs pas/ des na dar gcig la sgom yod med kho na la bya dgos te/ ci'i phyir na/ dran med kyi gnas cha'i ting 'dzin ni chad mtha'am 'gog par 'gyur la/ dran med kyi rnam rtog rang kha ma ni 'jig rten tha 415) mal pa dang khyad med yin phyir/ de gnyis gang yang phyag rgya chen po'i lam du mi 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ 'o na dran pas brkyang ba de ka bcos ma ru mi 'gro'am zhe na/ de gnyis gang yang phyag rgya chen po'i lam du ma 'gro ba'i phyir ro/ de ni sems kyi gnas tshul lam babs tshul gang snang de nyid la rang ngo shes par byed pa tsam ma gtogs dgag bsgrub gzhan bya ba ma yin pa'i phyir na bcos ma'i skyon du mi 'gyur te/

dran rig gi zin phyin chad cir shar thams cad chos sku'i rang bzhin du ma gyur ba rdul tsam yang med de/ ji skad du sems nyid ngal gso las/ gang skyes gnyug ma nyid yin phyir// gang shar dran pas ma brjod na// de shar stong pa nyid dag tu// rnal 'byor dbang phyug gdon mi za// ces 'di lta bu'i gnad kyis zin na sgom du 416) ma gyur pa'i chos med tshe/ dgag sgrub spang blang 'ching grol las 'das pa'i don mthong ba ste/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdolas/ rigs kyi bu/ chos gcig shes pas yon tan gyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur te/ gcig gang zhe na/ gang gi de kha na nyid yongs su shes pa'o/ ces dang*/ rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje zag med 'od phung du gshegs pa'i zhal chems las/ yin par grub pa med pa 'di// rang mdangs 'char tshul cir yang ma 'gag pas// snang srid kun kyang chos sku'i zhing du shar// shar ba de nyid rang gi thog tu grol// ces dang*/ rje sgam po pas/ rnam rtog sgom du ma shar na// gang byed 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin// sgom chen sgom gyis ma bcings na// gzhan gyis 'ching bar mi nus pas// go ba'i lta ba rgyab tu bor// 417) bsgom pa'i nyams myong rmag nas bshig /ces dang*/ grub thob o rgyan pas/ tha mal shes pa rang ga ni ma bsgom chos kyi sku ru shar// sangs rgyas rang gi sems las brnyes// 'khor 'das re dogs su dga' gyis// ces dang*/ khro phu lo tsas/ nyon mongs bkag pas ma khegs tshe// gdams ngag rgyal po sau sor gzhag byung*/ ngang la bzhag pas dbyings su yal// blang dor bya ba'i ming yang med// ces sogs gsungs pa ltar gang shar dran pas skyong ba'am ma bcos bzo med du glod pa la goms tshe rtsol med kyi dran pa la dka' las med do/ ci'i phyir na/ dran pa skyong mkhan dang skyong ba gnyis su ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ spyir phyag chen rang la bla ma so so'i bzhed tshul mang ba dang*/

dbye bsdu mdzad tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis/ 'dir bshad ma thag pa'i lung 'dren 'di 418) dag dang*/ dran pa bskyang mkhan dang skyong rgyu gnyis su med pa sogs kyi chos skad 'di dag rnal 'byor bzhi'i skabs ltar na ro gcig gi chos skad bar snang tshe/ las dang sa'o nyams len skyong tshul bshad pa'i 'phro 'dir mi 'gasam snyam na/ de ma yin te/ don dam nyams len dngos rang cig skyong shes pa'i gdams ngag gsar bu dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dngos gnyis la brtan pa thob ma thob ma gtogs gzhan gcig ste/ de ltar ma yin na da lta nyams len byas pa'i don med par 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ma yin pa la nyams su blangs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ des na 'gag tu hril gyi dril na/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas zhig la mos gus drag po dang mnyes pa gsum gyis brten cing gdams ngag zab mo thob rjes tshig tshogs kyi rnam grangs la mi 'byams 419) par/ chig dril gyi snying po dang du len nus na byin rlabs kyi tshan khas rang grol du 'gro bar 'dug rung*/ deng sang rnyigs ma'i mtha' la thug pa'i rang tshul 'di lta bur/ bla ma dang slob ma gnyis ka'i rten 'brel tshad ldan zhig ni u dum wa ra ltar dkon tshe/ nyams myong dang rtog pa gsha' mar 'byung ba rang ni nyin skar dang 'dra bar sems so/ ༈ yang nyid kyi dri yig tu phyag chen rnal 'byor bzhi'i dang po rtse gcig chung ngu la sgom gyi sna zin nam ma zin/ gsungs 'dug par/ spyir gdams ngag gi blo rigs dang dbang rim la bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung kyang mdor bsdu na/ gcig car rim gyis thod rgal ba dang gsum du 'dus pas/ de dag so sor 'char tshul mi 'dra ba mtha' yas phyir phyogs gcig tu nges bzung ga la nus shing*/ spyi khyab tu ni/ rtse gcig sogs rnal 'byor bzhi 420) rim can du 'char ba'i dbang du bgyi na/

rtse gcig chung ngu la sgom sna los kyang zin te/ ci'i phyir na/ legs sbyar gyi skad du yo ga dang*/ bod skad du rnal 'byor zhes pa'i nges tshig ltar na/ sems nyid ma bcos rnal ma'i don la rang dbang 'byor pa la snal 'byor du brjod pa yin tshe/ sgom gyi sna tsam yang ma zin par rnal 'byor gyi don ji ltar brjod/ spyir yang sgom zhes bya ba'i ming tsam 'jug pa ni mang mod kyang*/ 'di skabs su ni ched du sgom rgyu med rung tha mal du skad cig kyang mi yengs pa la sgom skyong ba zhes ming du btags phyir zha gnas la'ang sgom pa'i ming tsam ni btags mod kyi/ sgom dngosagazhi ni lhag mthong gi don ngo 'phrod pa la bya dgos shing*/ lhag mthong rtogs phyin chad rtse gcig gi sna zin pa yang yin la sna nges par zin pa dang*/ sna zin tsam gyis 421) chog pa ni ma yin phyir/ shor ba bzhi dang gol sa gsum sogs 'dra min rnams su ma shor mthar 'o na dgos pa ni gor ma chags so/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ zhang rin po ches gsungs pa lung du drang bar mdzad de/ rtse gcig dus su ngo bo rtog pa dang*/ rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams pa sogs kyi dbye ba gang gis byed gsungs pa ni/ de yang zhi lhag zung 'jug gi nyams len skyon med gcigago 'phrod nas/ mnyam gzhag gi dus na mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dgos par gsungs te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ yul med du rang ngo shes pas gsal ba yid gnyis kyi 'gyu ba chad dngas pa/ blo'i snyom byed dang bral bas phra ba/ gnas lugs gzhi rtsa chod pas mi rtog pa dang bzhi po tshang bar nyams su blang tshe/

ngo bo stong la rtog pa med pa'i rang bzhin bde gsal 'gag med zhen 422) bral du yer re rjen ne hrig ge bar gnas pa de nyid gnas lugs kyi ngo bo rtogs pa yin mod cing*/ de nyid kyang re yong re mi yong bar mtho dman nam skye 'bri lta bur snang ba dang*/ rjes la'ang gang zag gi blo rigs kyi khyad par las/ gzhan zhig la bden med du bun ne phyam me bar 'gro na mnyam gzhag gnad du song ba'i skad yin la/ rjes a 'thas shas che na gnad du cung mang song ba'i rtags yin pa dang*/ mdor na 'di skabs kyi mnyam gzhag la rtse gcig chung ngur bzhed pa lags shing*/ rtse gcig mun par 'byams pa ni zhi gnas stong po ba lta bu la gsungs phyir/ de ni gnas cha rkyang pa ma shor ste lhag mthong gis ma zin pas rtse gcig mtshan nyid par mi 'gro zhing*/ sgom skyon can gyi rnam grags lags mod/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ skabs 'dir nyams len 'di mthar 'don 423) pa'i thabs gang gtso ces gsungs bar spyir yang chos lam du 'gro ba dang mtha' mthun par byed pa'i thabs ni/ nges byung dag snang mos gus snying rje zhen lo brtson 'grus sogs dgos tshul ni chos thams cad mthun mod cing*/ khyad par 'di skabs tshor yang tshe 'di'i bya byed dang rnam g.yeng dgra ltar spangs nas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs dbang bzhi blangs ba sogs kha tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas byas te byin rlabs 'jug nges pa'i thabs dang*/ mnyam gzhag la chig 'dril du 'bad cing*/ rjes thob kyang dran pa rtsis su byas la/tshe 'di snang gi bsam spyod kyi bar du ma chod par bya ba kho na mchog tu gces par gsung mod kyi/ ding sang gi sgom chen par ming btags nas longs spyod dang skyid 'dod kyi zhen pa blo phugs su bcangs pa rnams la ni/ rtse gcig chung ngu tsam du ma 424) zad 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom pa tsam yang blo yul la 'khor ba'ang dka' bar sems so/
