༈ yang nyid kyis/ rtse gcig skabs su ngo bo rtogs pa de las lhag pa rtogs rgyu yod dam med/ gsungs pa la ngo bo mthong ba'am gnas lugs rtogs pa tsan ni dang po sems ngo 'phrod pa'i skabs nas phal cher la 'byung yang*/ tshul bzhin nyams su len cing bla mas byin rlabs zhugs pa rnams rim bzhin gong nas gong du 'bog 'don rgyu dang rtsal rdzogs rgyu nges shes rnyed rgyu sogs dang*/ de la brten pa'i yon tan gyi rnam grangs mang du 'char rgyu ni los kyang yong la/ ngo bo rtags rgyu lhags su yod med ni gong du bshad pa ltar gtso bor gdams ngag gi rigs la rag las phyir mtha' gcig tu brjod par dka' zhing*/ rgyal sras spom brag pa dang*/ dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub sogs la ni sku bu chung gi rnam par bzhugs skabs nas/ 425) ting 'dzin bzang po rtsol med du shar zhing*/ rjes nas thugs rje dngos gsan pa'i tshe sngar gyi de las lhag pa'i bogs 'don rgyu cher ma byung ba'i tshul dang*/ ༈ rje sgam po ba'i slob ma ra rji ras pa dang*/ ༈ rje mchog chos rje sogs ni bla ma'i gdan sa thog mar mthong ba sogs las ro gcig gi rtogs pa 'khrungs tshul sogs kyi dpe ltar/ so so'i skal ba dang blo khyad byin rlabs zhugs ma zhugs kyi so mtshams sogs la rag las pa ma lags sam/ don du ni ngo bo tsam rtogs sa la khyad med rung*/ nyid kyi shun pa'am zhen 'dzin sems dag ma dag gi khyad par ni shin tu yang che bar gsal zhing*/ 'dir 'og ma'i mnyam gzhag gong ma'i rjes thob tu 'gyur bar yang bshad la/ khyad med na rnal 'byor bzhi rim can du bshad pa yang dgos pa 426) med par 'gyur bas so/ lar yang*/ sems kyi ngo bo rjen par mthong tsam ni slar yang*/ nyams len la brtson 'grus zhan pas rnal 'byor bzhi rdzogs par 'char ba'am ngo bo bye brag tu rtogs pa ni dkon par snag mod kyang*/ tshig dang yi ge'i kha khyer tsam ma gtogs bsgom pa'i nyams myong nang nas shar ba'i rtogs ldan gsha' ma zhig rang gang du btsal kyang re zhig dkon pa 'dra lags/

༈ yang nyid kyis 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang rin po ches gsungs pa bzhin/ spros bral dpyid rta sgal chad kyi dpe drangs pa'i skyon gyi bye brag pa chos sku dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ stong par rtogs pa sogs yon tan gyi bye brag rnams kyi dbye ji ltar 'byed gsungs pa dang*/ spros bral dus gsum 427) 'khor 'das dang nyams rtogs sogs kyi so mtshams ji ltar dbye dang*/ rnal 'byor gong ma gnyis la'ang de bzhin du dbye bsdu dang skyon yon sogs kyi rgyas bshad gyis ces gsungs 'dug pa/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor bzhi po thams cad kyi dbye bsdu dang dgongs don gnad 'gag skyon sogs thams cad tshul bzhin du brjod nus pa ni sangs rgyas nyid dam/ de dang/mtshungs pa'i skyes chen dkar 'brug 'bri gung stag tshal thel sogs kyi grub thob gong ma rnams dang*/ rgyal ba yab sras lta bu rnams ma gtogs gdams ngag phal pa dag gis brjod par dka' mod kyang*/ khyad par bdag dang bdag 'dra'i rigs can gis ni sgra bar ci zhig nus te/ ci'i phyir na/ de dag gi gnad don tshul bzhin brjod par byed pa la rang nyid nyams rtogs kyi sa mtshams de thams cad bsgrod cing mngon du gyur pa zhig dgos la/ de ltar ma gyur bzhin kha khyer du 428) bshad pas ni don la mi 'bab ste/ dpe ci dang 'dra na/ rdo rje gdan du ma phyin pas de'i bkod pa bshad pa'am/ gso rig mi shes par sman pa byed pa ltar mkhas grub rnams kyis 'khrol ba'i rgyu las ma mchis med/ 'on kyang rnal 'byor bzhi'i mtshan nyid brda' mtshon tsam zhig brjod na/ de yang gnas pa'i ting 'dzin ji lta bar ngo 'phrod cing skyong shes la cung zad goms pa'i dbang gis skye 'bri'am gsal 'grib nges med lta bu ni sngar bshad pa ltar rtse gcig chung ngu*/ de ma goms nas ji tsam goms goms 'ong ba rtse gcig 'bring po/ de nyid mtshan 'khor yug tu 'ong ba rtse gcig chen po/

de nas rtse gcig gi nyams kyi shun pa bud nas stong nyid blo bral rang bzhin med par rtogs shing 'khor 'das so mtshams phyed pa ni spros bral chung ngu*/ nyams rtogs kyi 429) shan pa rang bzhin du chod cing 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad gsal stong zung 'jug gi klong du thag chod pa ni spros bral 'bring po/ 'di yan chad nas rtsa ba'i dam tshig ma nyams na bar do chod tshar bar bshad/ de nas rnam rtog phra mo skyes kyang skye grol dus mnyam du 'gro zhing bsgom pa'i rtsol ba las 'das pa spros bral chen po/ de nas gzung 'dzin sems su yal/ snang sems dngos su 'dres pas rdzu 'phrul cung zad kyang ston par nus la/ phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen 'bras gsum sogs rten 'brel rag pa brtsi shes pa ro gcig chung ngu*/ de nas sems la rang dbang thob cing snang ba la rang byan tshud pas dran kyang sgom la ma dran kyang sgom kho nar song ba ro gcig 'bring po/ de nas rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing snang cha'i rten 'brel 430) rtsal rdzogs su bsgrigs shes pas rdzu 'phrul la rang dbang thob pa ro gcig chen po/ de nas shes bya'i sgrib pa'am rang ngo shes pa'i rang grib lta bu zhig ma gtogs las nyon gyi sgrib pa'am bag chags thams cad zad cing mnyam rjes thun mtshams las 'das pa ni sgom med chung ngu*/ phyi snang ba dang nang 'jig rten pa'i 'gyu dran gyi cha shas tsam kyang dag cing dag cing ngo shes kyi dran pa yang rang sar dag nas 'od gsal ma bu 'dres pa ni sgom med 'bring po/ de nas dran rig gi ngo bo nyid kyang blo 'das su grol te bdag gi 'dzin yul dang byed po'i ming tsam yang med par chos zad blo 'das chen por grol ba la sgom med chen por brjod do/ de yang ji skad du/ rtse gcig gnas pa bsgom du byed// spros bral stong pas kha dog khyer// ro gcig bsgom pa'i blo tsam yod// sgom med blo zad chos zad yin// ces gsungs la de dag mdor

431) bsdus pa'i ngos 'dzin mu stegs ni/ rnam rtog la gnyen pos 'jug dgos na rtse gcig dran tsam la ngo bo rnyed na spros bral/ snang thog tu grol thub na ro gcig bsgom bya bsgom byed zad pa sgom med du bzhed do/ bogs 'don ni/ rtse gcig gi bogs brtson 'grus kyis 'don/ spros bral gyi bogs mos gus kyis 'don/ ro gcig gi bogs snying rjes 'don/ sgom med la bogs 'don rgyu dang bral ba'o/ gegs sel ni/ rtse gcig gi gegs gzhag thabs thabs kyis bsal/ spros bral gyi gegs sgom nyid kyi bsal/ ro gcig sgom med gnyis gegs kyi yul las 'das pa'o/ ces gsungs so/ de ltar 'di dag ni brda' mtshon tsam du lags shing*/ 'dir kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs kyis ni nyams kyis rnal 'byor bzhi dang rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi dbye bar mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang 'di dag gis rgyas 432) bshad ltar na/ ༈ rje sgom chung zhabs kyis ni/ ngos 'dzin lugs bzhi/ rtogs lugs bzhi/ 'khor sa bzhi/ skyed tshul bzhi/ dri ma bzhi/ dag tshul bzhi/ sa mtshams bzhi/ mkhyen tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i phra zhib dang*/ ༈ rje phag mos grub pas rnam grangs bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang*/ ༈ rje 'brug pas ni/ ngo bo mthong ma mthong*/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar/ yon tan skyes ma skyes/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma byan tshud ma tshud/ gzhan don gzugs sku dang 'gro don sa thebs ma thebs sogs kyi mu dbye dang*/ phyis nas sgam po pa bkra shis rnam rgyal bas kyang de dang mtshungs pa dbye bar mdzad snang phyir/ phra zhib kyi dbye ba dang dogs gcod thams cad de dag tu mdzad 'chal zhing*/ khyad par snying po don gyi gter mdzod sogs la khyod rang gi gzigs rtogs gnang yod pa 'dug pas/ ༈ 433) rdo rje 'chang dngos bka' rgyud rin po che de dag gis gsungs pas las lhag pa zhig ding sang bdag lta bus bshad kyang mi shes/

dgos kyang mi dgos pa lta bu lags pas de dag rnams su sgro 'dogs gcod pa zhu zhing*/ 'gags don gyi mchog tu ni/ nyid ma mdo rgyud man ngag mang po la thos bsam mdzad pa zhig ni gzhir byas la/ khyad par bla ma mchog la bstan nas zab mo'i gdams ngag la sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*/ ding sang kyang phyag rgya chen po'i zab bzhes dri ma med par skyong ba gnang los yod tshe/ rang rig chos sku'i rang zhal mjal ba las lhag pa'i nyams len gyi bogs 'don gzhan la re ba'i yul gyis dben pa dang*/ tshig dang yi ge'i spros pas dgos pa med tshe/ lam rang byung snying rje'i rang 'grel la 'jug pa ni gnad kyi gdams pa yang dag pa la lags sam/ gzhan yang nyid kyi yi ger 434) spros bral gsum gyi skabs na/ 'di'i ngar 'don la thabs shes gang gtso gsungs snang ba/ 'di ni spros bral kho nar ma zad thog mtha' bar gsum gang du'ang thabs shes gnyis ya ma bral lam rkyang par ma song ba zung du 'brel ba zhig ni spyir yang rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'dir nan ltar gal che la/ khyad par 'di dag gi skabs tshor ni/ shes rab stong nyid la ji tsam bsgom kyang bgos ma 'thon na stong pa mthar lhung la nye ba'i rtags yin tshe/ thabs kyi bye brag sna tshogs la khyad du mi gsad par 'bad 'bungs ston pas bogs nges par 'byung ba dang*/ ༈ yang thabs la bogs ma 'thon sheb kyi rtsis ma zin par thabs brkyang la shor ba'i rtags yin pas/ 'dus byas sam rtsol byas la a ma 'thas par chos dbyings stong pa nyid 'khor gsum yongs dag ma bcos klong yangasakhyab gdal 'dus 435) ma byas kyi ngang du glod pas bogs nges par 'thon par gsungs la/ dmigs bsal du ni spros bral 'bring tsam man chad du ni thabs la nan cher bya ba dang*/ de yan chad du ni stong pa kha khyer gyi gegs la ma shor ba'i ngos nas shes la gtsor bya ba gnad zab par gsungs shing*/ gzhan du na/ sngar bshad pa gdams ngag gi dbang rim la yang ltos phyir gcig tu ma nges pa dang*/

gang ltar na'ang thabs shes ya bral ba ni gcig tu gces par go ste/ dper na bya nam 'phangs gcod pa yang 'dab chags thams cad ya ma bral ba ni gcig tu gces par go ste/ dper na bya nam 'phangs gcod pa la yang 'dab gshog thamasacad tshang dgos pa bzhin no/ yang thabs kyi rim pa'i rigs ni rgyud sde'i nyams len gyi rim pa so so'i rang gzhung dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag phyag bzhes kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas phyir rang rang gi lugs mthun par 'bad dgos pa nyid do/ ༈ yag nyid kyis/ chung 436) 'bring gnyis kyis bar do ji ltar bsgrod/ gsungs snang ba de nyid gong du spros bral 'bring po yan la bar do mi 'byung bar bshad pa bzhin yin la/ ༈ yang bar do'i sgra bshad dang zhib dbye'i dbang du byas na/ rnying lugs kyi bar do thos grol sogs dang dgongs pa mthun/ rje mi las bkra bshis tshe ring ma la gdams pa'i bar do 'phrang grol gyi skabs sogs su ni 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bar do'i rang bzhin du bstan mod cing*/ de dag gi rgyas bshad ni 'dir ma brjod la/ nyid kyi bris pa ltar gyi chos nyid srid pa'i bar do'i grol tshul mdor bsdu na rnam 'byor pa bla ma'i dam tshig dang nyams len la zhe thag pa nas brtson 'grus dang ldan pa zhig la ni/ spros bral tsam du ma slebs rung rtse gcig chen po sogs su tshe'i dus byas shing*/ mtshams sbyor ngan pa gzhan gyi bar du chod na/ gzhi'i 'od gsal rgya mtsho lta bu dang mal gyi 'od gsal 437) chu sna lta bu gnyis 'dres nas grol ba shas che ste/ rtse gcig chen po nyams kyi 'khor yug de nyid bar dor gzhi'i 'od gsal shar ba dang 'phrad tshe rtogs pa yang dag tu gyur nas grol bar bshad de/ de nyid grol thub mi thub kyi tshad ni da lta gnyid kyi skabs su dge sbyor khor yug song ma song kho nas shes la/ nam du'ang dam tshig la nyes ltung med ltung med pa zhig ni gal che ba kho na nar gsungs so/

༈ yang nyid kyis/ sgrib pa gsum nam gyi dus nas bsags la mthar nam du dag ces gsungs pa la/ 'di la sgrib pa gsum po rang yang 'dren mi gcig pa mang kyang*/ spyi tsam du ni/ gong du 'khrul lugs phyag chen bshad pa'i skabs ltar gzhi la 'khrul pa'am sgrib pa med kyang blo bur gyi dri ma yin pa dang*/ de nyid kyang lhan cig skyes kyi ma rig pa shar ba nas brtsams te las nyon gyi 338) sgrib pa bsags shing 'khor ba 'khyams la/ 'khyams bzhin du bag chags lu gu rgyud du mtshams sbyar nas rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo bskyed pa lags mod/ mthar nam gyi tshe dag na/ nyams len zab mo'i lam 'dir mi 'jug pa rnams la ni slar yang nas yang nas yang du lam sgrib mang du bsnon cing 'khor ba mtha' med du 'gyur ba las 'os ma mchis la/ 'ga' zhig lam la ma zhugs kyang rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang*/ rnam dkar gyi 'bras bu dag gis rgyu rkyen byas te gong du 'phags pa yang 'byung zhing*/ byang chub kyi nye rgyu dngos ni lam zab 'di lta bu la ma brten pa'i thabs med pa dang*/ 'di skabs kyi brjod don dngos ni/ rtse gcig skabs ci rigs pa man chad nas las nyon gyi sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ ro gcig man chad nas bag chags kyi sgrib pa dag pa dang*/ sgom med chung 'bring yan chad nas shes bya'i sgrib pa'am mchog 439) 'dzin dang nges shes lta bu'i dri ma mtha' dag kyang dbyings su nus pas bsgom med chen po mthar phyinapar brjod la/ de nas gzhan pa'i phra zhib kyi dbye ba dang sa mtshams mtshan nyid theg pa nas gsungs pa'i sa bcu lam lnga dang 'di'i rnal 'byor bzhi gsum bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i bshad pa sogs ni bka' brgyud gong ma'i gsung sgros rnams las 'byung phyir/ blo dman bdag 'dras yang skyor du bshad pas ci zhig bya/ mdor na de dag gi skabs tshor bla ma la las ni sa bcu lam lnga dang rnal 'byor bzhi sbyar ba skabs mi 'bab par bzhed/

la las ni shin tu 'byor pa'i tshul gsungs pa sogs sna tshogs par snang mod kyang*/ don dam par ni/ gsang ba'i myur lam zab mo 'di lta bu'i mthar phyin tshe/ sa lam gyi yon tan mtha' dag rang bzhin lhun rdzogs su gyur yin phyir theg pa 440) 'og ma'i dbang bsgrod kyang rung*/ ma bsgrod kyang rung ste/ don du thams cad rang snang yin pa'i phyir dang*/ 'bras bu mngon du gyur pa'i dus na lam gyi bya rtsol las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ yang nyid kyis/ snang ba'i 'od gsal dang snang med kyi 'od gsal gnyis so sor gang nas 'char zhing ji ltar ngos 'dzin gsungs pa las/ spyir 'od gsal gyi sgra tsam 'jug pa ni mang mod kyang*/ nges don gyi skabs 'di dngas pa'am/ gsal ba'am/ sgrib g.yog med pa'am/

'char sgo 'gags pa sogs la 'jug cing*/ de la snang med kyi 'od gsal dang snang ba'i 'od gsal gnyis su phye ba 'di dag chos drug gi skabs sogs su bshad pa'i nyams kyi 'od gsal dang rtogs pa'i 'od gsal rnams dang don gcig par bzhed la/ de nas 'od gsal gyi mchog ni gzhi'i 'od gsal yin zhing*/ de la snang med kyi 'od gsal dang*/ stong nyid kyi 'od gsal 441) dang*/ don dam pa'i 'od gsal sogs su brjod la/ mdo nas kyang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'o// ces gsungs pa 'di ni 'gro ba kun la ye khyab tu gnas med kyang de dang de ma shes pa'i bla ma'i gdams ngag gis ngo sprad pa la lam gyi 'od gsal du brjod cing*/ rtogs pa'i 'od gsal kyang 'di ka yin pa dang*/ 'di ni rtse gcig nas bzung ste rang la rang gsal du 'char nas/ bsgom med la mngon du 'gyur ba lags mod/ 'od gsal 'di'i gdangs sam gsal snang lta bu'i bye brag la ni dpe don rtags gsum gyis sgo nas ngo sprod cing nyams su blangs thabs khyad par ba bdag nyid rnying ma'i rdzogs chen rnams su mchis pa dang*/ der ma zad spyi ltar na'ang phyi rol 'byung ba lnga sogs snod bcud kyi rang tshul dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i 'char tshul 'di thams cad kyang*/ don du rang snang logs su grub 442) pa med pas ngo bo stong zhing*/ rnam pa 'gags med cir yang 'char bas na snang ba'i 'od gsal yin pa dang*/ nang ltar na rtsa rlung khams kyi byed bcings dang rten 'brel las byung ba'i dud sogs rtags bcu'am/ de tsam du yang ma zad par par dbang po drug gi spyod yul du gyur tshad dang*/ dag pa sku dang zhing khams kyi 'char sgo ma dag 'dre gdon 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo sogs mtha' dag kyang snang ba'i 'od gsal du ma gyur pa rdul tsam yang med la/ 'di thams cad gdams ngag tha mal pa rnams kyis ni de'i rang bzhin ma shes pas mi bden pa la bden par bzung zhing 'khrul pa a 'thas nying mtshams sbyar bas phan gnod kyi rgyu ltar byed la/

lam pa'i rnal 'byor rnams kyis ni de dag gi yin tshul shes pa'i sgo nas skabs so so'i gnad kyi gdams pas zin tshe nyams len gyi rgyu'am grogs su shar ba dang*/ 'bras bu mngon 443) gyur rnams la ni snang mi snang*/ 'char mi 'char/ 'od gsal sogs kyi ming dang tha snyad kyi gdags gzhi zad cing*/ 'dzin pa'i gtod phur bud tshe snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i klong du rgya 'byams pas 'od gsal yang dag gi don mthar phyin pa nyid do/ des na skabs 'dir rnal 'byor bzhi tshul bzhin du rtogs pa'i gdams ngag la ni 'od gsal gnyis po zung 'jug kho nar rtag tu gnas tshe/ 'di tsam nas 'char dang 'di ltar ngos bzung zhes pa'i zur gsal mi dgos par go zhing phra zhib kyi gnad rnamasacis kyang shes par 'dod na bar do na bar do 'phrang grol gyi 'grel pa sogs su blta bar bya'o/ 'gags don gyi snying por gsol na/ rnal 'byor gang zhig tshe 'di blo yis thongs shing sangs rgyas don du gnyer ba kho na yin phyin chad/ bla ma 444) mtshan ldan gyi drung du gnad kyi gdar sha legs par gcad la/ mi med kyi lung stong 'grim zhing lto dgos gtam sogs chos brgyad kyi zhen pa gting nas btang bas tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa zhig la ni gegs dang bar chad kyi yul las 'das shing*/ rnal 'byor bzhi sogs nyams rtogs drod rtags ji bzhin pa mi 'char ba'i thabs kyang ma mchis la/ byin rlabs gsha' ma zhig zhu shing rtogs pa tshul bzhin shar na thun mong gi drod rtags yon tan mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs ni mi 'dod kyang shugs la 'byung ba dang*/ yon tan mngon du gyur tshe sgom byung gi shes rab nang nas shar ba zhing chos kyi mjed rang la brdol bas phyi rol gyi tshig dang yi ge la rag ma lus pa dang*/ sa lam gyi rim pa rnams kyang bsgrod ma bsgrod sleb ma sleb pa sogs kyi gnyis 'dzin dang*/

re 'dod zhe 'dod mtha' dag gtan zad du 445) gyur pa de 'dra zhig la blo phug ma gtad na/ 'o skol gyi snyigs ma'i sems can las ngan bag chags kyi phung por gyur tshe/ ma bslab par shes 'dod/ ma sgom par nyams rtogs 'byung 'dod/ zla shas lo shas tsam la grub rtagasa'athon 'dod/ snyan grags gdul bya 'gro don sogs gzhan las lhag pa zhig 'dod pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi go 'phang gang las kyang mtho ba zhig byas nas/ chos pa'am rtogs ldan du rlom pa kho na mang tshe/ 'di lta bu'i dus la rnal 'byor bzhi sogs la lam gyi yon tan dang*/ ming snyan snyan rnams bshas rung ngal ba don med dang*/ yi ge'i 'khres so las mi 'ong bar sems pas/ 'di tsam las rgyas pa 'bul bar ma spobs lags tshe/ dgongs dbyings zab mo 'khrel 'khrungs med pa yang mkhyen mkhyen lags/ e ma/ thub bstan lha lam yangs pa'i dbyings rum na// sgrub rgyud 446) skra tshogs 'bum phrag bkra ba'i dbus// rab gsal bdag rgyud zla snang ches 'bar zhing*/ gdul bya'i chu snod gang 'tshams der 'pho ba'i// skal ldan kun bzhad mdzad phyag chen 'od// 'gro blo'i yid mun bsal ba'i sgron mchog gang*// snyigs mtha'i dmar phyogs tshes longs spyod babs dang*/ des med li khri'i sprin bsgribs kye ma hud// rnam 'dren mu stegs do shal rab 'thor zhing*// sgrub tshogs lo ka'i sha ra bha rir 'dzegs// 'di snang longs spyod rgyags mdzes bsgyings pa yis// zhen pa phyi nang bsgyur log ma gyur gral// gzhung lugs chu klung lnga brgya'i ngom na yang*// gnas lugs kai la sha rtse ma gzigs pas// srid 'byor a wa les btams ma drod cher// rtag brtan gdengs can mang pos sa 'dis brgyan// bzhad pa rdo rje 'u ku la'i// go chas mdzes mthong dran pa bzhin// sra brtan bgos 447) mtshon rab 'chang ba'i// tshogs 'di sgrub rgyud chos dbyings gshegs// phyag rgya cher grags kha ba'i rdul// mngon brtsegs la gnas gdong lnga'i tshogs// rtogs pa'i g.yu ral lan gcig tsam// sprug log sde gzhom cis mi mdzad// ma hā sa na'i dpal ldan rnams// theg rtse'i ral gri mi 'phyar na// bas mtha'i yu mo zung nan ltar/

/brdung ba'i rtsol ba ngal bar za// dal 'byor rkang 'thung thos bsam yal 'dab ni// ma rgyas gnyis rgyas 'du ba'i rnam g.yeng la// ma rang tshang tshing 'khrig pa'i nags ljongs su// yib la rnal 'byor bzhi yis dris ma gos// rig lung smra ba'i 'khur gyi ma nan cing*/ sna tshogs shes bya'i gser 'dras yang ma g.yog /mkhas grub grags skam mche drug ma ldan pa'i// nags kyi gnyis 'thung su zhig ci phyir mgu /smra ba'i rgyu 448) med smra ba'i spobs pa'ang bral// smra la dga' min smras kyang ngal ba zad// de phyir dri lan 'don pa'i 'khur bzhes can// gzhan la byāñdza'i dri bsung spro bar 'os// rnying lugs sngags 'chang zog po'i gyur gnas kyang*// bsrung bzlog sad gsum lam la 'khyog myong*/ nyams rtogs lbu 'khreng dkar po 'khrig min tshe// bshags tshogs rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i nus rtsal dben// sangs rgyas mngon sum 'ga' grib bsil babs mthus// ma hā san+ti'i rdzing bu nyams dga' bar// bzlog med mal du zhe 'dod ca co'i brtsom// rab bskyung gu yang 'khyil las gzhan du min// blos bcos bde gsal mi rtog lam rtags kyi// yon tan ltar snang bslu mkhas lus phra ma// 'bum la'ang smon pa'i 'gram chu mi sdang na// rnal 'byor rim lhan lhun bsgrod sems bral/ / 449) gang shar cir snang rig pa'i rnam rol la// zhen 'dzin gser gyi lug rgyud ma brkyang tshe// bde sdug skye 'chi 'khor 'das cir btags kun// kun bzang yangs pa chen por e ma ho// gdod nas dag pa'i zhing khams yang dog dang*/ mtha' dbus las 'das 'dus ma byas dbyings su// rig stong bla ma chos sku'i rang zhal dngos// mthong bya mthong byed mtshan ma'i spros bral mthong*/ lam 'dir 'jug pa'i skal ldan ming yang med// bdag gi lhag bsam bden pa'i nus mthu dang*/ rmad byung rgyal ba'i thugs rje stobs ldan mthus// sgrub rgyud snying po'i bstan mchog rgyas par smon// tshul bzhin dris la don mthun lan ldon pa'i// chos spobs bral yang nam dkar bsam pas 'dir// gnas lugs ji bzhin bshad pa'i dge 'bras kyis//

'gro kun ye shes phyag rgya che 'grub shog /1$0000180 de ltar chos thams cad kyi snying po'i yang zhun mchog tu gyur pa nges don phyag rgya chen po zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i dgongs don legs par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor smon lam gyi mtshan can gang des dri yig gnang ba la brten nas sna tshogs rang grol gyis rang nyid la 1$10001801$10002501$10002501$00002501$10001801$0000180'di dag gi dgongs don rtogs pa'i cha shas tsam yang med rung*/ bka' rgyud gong ma'i gsung rgyun dag la brten te/ tshul 'di shar phyogs dpal ri gangs kyi sko ngag gnas chen rgod tshang phug la mkhros 'du ba'i yang dben gyis mtshams mal nas/ dge sbyor gyi thun mtshams dag tu bris pa'i dgebs 'gro ba thams cad sku bzhi dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig 1$10002501$00002501$10001801$0000180451) yig drug gi dmigs rim mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ 1$10002501$0000250hrīḥ 'khor 'das snod bcud gdod nas dag pa'i zhing*/ 'gag med rang gsal phyi rol yul gnas kun// rnam dag zhing khams ri bo tā la nyid// bdag gzhan skye 'gro'i phung khams dbang rnams// 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs// snang khams rang bzhin ma grub 1$10001801$10002501$10001801$10002501$1000250'od kyi sku// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dang po'i phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar// 'og ma g.yas g.yon shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin// long sku'i cha lugs pad zlar rdor dkyil// spyi gtsug bla ma 'od dpag med pas mtshan// thugs kar 'dab drug lte bar hrīḥ// mtha' skor yig drug 'khor zhing 'od zer 'phros// sems can sdug bsngal kun zhi 'gro drug tshogs// 'phags pa'i skur gyur ngag sngags yid chos nyid// ye shes dkyil 'khor khyab gdal

452) chen por gyur// om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ 1$0000180zhes rgyun ma chad par bzla zhing*/ ༈ k+ṣun mtshams 'jog pa'i skabs su smon lam gdams zhing*/ 1$10002501$0000250sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i mthus// bdag sogs mkha' khyab sems can thams cad kun// thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang thob par shog /1$10001801$0000180 ces pa'i smon lam gcab cing*/ bdag gzhan thams cad thugs rje chen po dngos dmigs pa'i dag snang ma brjed par rgyun du dran par bya'o/ 'di ni smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling gi 'dus pa rnams kyi zhal 'don mdzad rgyur/ yon tan dbang phyug dang don gnyis mchog grub sogs don gnyer rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bkod pa dge'o/ 1$10002501$0000250 453) byang sdom rgyun khyer du nyams su blangs pa'i cho ga rin chen myu gu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ 454) tshad med pa'i thugs rje'i mnga' dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 1$10002501$1000180 theg chen byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i rim pa gsum las/ zab mo lta ba'i rgyud pa las byung ba bzhin rgyun khyer du nyams su blang ba'i thabs ni/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i tshogs bsags pa/ dngos gzhi skyabs sems blang ba/ rjes spro ba bskyed cing smon lab gdab pa rnams las dang po ni/ rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshams pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar dkon mchog ma lus pa bskyed la/ 455) dad gus drag pos tshig don mthun pas 'di 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chogs la// bdag dang pha ma mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// grangs med lus btud gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sems can grangs mtha' yas la yun ring du// bde bar gshegs kyi bde ba bla na med// yid la bsam pa mtha' dag rdzogs byed pa// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*// mchod rten kun la

456) phyag 'tshal lo// mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang*// brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ mchod pa ni/ rin chen sems de bzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin bshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la gus pas mchod// dngos bshams yid kyid sprul dang blos blangs pa'i// mchod pa'i dngos po nam mkha' rab 'byams khams// yongs bkang mchod 'os rnams la bdag 'bul gyis// mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs su gsol// rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gi ni// lus dang longs spyod gtan du 'bul gyi na// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyod kyis 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// sdig bshags ni/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 457) na// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba na// tshe rabs 'di'im gzhan dag la// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa// bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni// rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa'i// nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags// bdag gi dkon mchog gsum dang ni// pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la// nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*/ yid kyis gnong bgyis gang lags dang*// nyes pa du ma'i skyon chags pa'i// sdig canabadag gis sdig pa gang*// shin tu mi zad bgyis pa gang*// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'am// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// de dag thams cad bzhags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyi bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par bzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po 458) ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yongs mi bgyi// rjes su yi rang ni/

sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal gso'i dge ba dang*/ sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyobs pa rnams kyis byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*/ chos bskor bskul ba ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun thum la// chos kyi sgron me spar du gsol// ma rig nyon mongs rmongs pa'i 'gro /chos kyi snang bas khyab mdzad gsol// 'khrul ba'i gcong rnying zug rngu'i nad// dam chos bdud rtsi gso mdzad gsol// 459) gsol ba'i yan lag ni/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas zhing rnams kyi// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// mgon po mchog nyid khams gsum gyi// thar ba'i lam mkhan dmigs bu ste// gang tshe zhi ba'i dbyings bzhugs pas// 'gro 'di ldongs par mi 'god cing*// bskal ba grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ dge ba bsngo ba ni/ de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*/ des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis ni// sems can thams cad ma lus pa// sdig pa thams cad spangs nas ni// rtag tu dge ba byed par shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyis ded dpon dang*// 'argal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid gyur cig /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' 460) bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog

/de bzhin nam mtha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams rnams rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'da' bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur gyur shog /bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten du ni myur du tshangs rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang gzigs kun grol shog / ༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blang ba ni/ dkon mchog la kha zhe med pa'i dad pa dang*// mkha' mnyam sems can la bzod med kyi byams rnying rje dang*/ de dag sgrol phyir rang nyid sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa rtse gcig dang ldan pas skyabs sems lan gsum gyi bar du blang bar bya'o/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi 461) ba 'di nas bzung ste/ byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi bder bshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de ltar rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du slob par bgyi// zhes lan gsum du nan tan gyis blangs pas smon 'jug gnyis ka thob pa yin no/ ༈ gsum pa spro bskyed smon lam dang bcas pa ni/

de lta bu'i byang sems rin po che blang ba thob pas da ni sangs rgyas sgrub pa la 'bad na mi rung bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa rnams la spang blang tshul bzhin 462) 'bad par bya'o snyam pa'i yid dam brtan po bya zhing*/ deng 'dir bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog pa mi 'gyur de ltar bya// 'gro ba'i mgron po srid pa'i lam rgyu zhing*/ /bde ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la// 'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gtad nas// sems can mgron chen tshim par byed pa yin// bdag gi de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyis// spyan sngar 'gro ba'i bder bshegs nyid dang ni// bar du de la mgron du 'bod zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// sems thams cad can bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar zhugs pa// de dag 463) kun gyi smon lam 'grub gyur cig /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas rnyed pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro kun sgrol bar shog /zab mo lta rgyud lugs kyi byang sdom len chog thun dang po'i nyams len rdzogs so/ ༈ rgya chen spyod kyi sems bskyed blang ba las/ smon 'jug gnyis la sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi/ sbyor ba la gsol gdab/ skyabs 'gro tshogs bsags gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkon mchog rnams la dad gus snying thag pa nas bskyed cing tshig rjes su don gsal la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde bzhin bshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang

464) byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyid pa yang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdabs so/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro ni/ skyabs dkon mchog rnams la 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i 465) chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ lan gsum gyi skyabs 'gro bya'o/ gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshig don 'dre ba'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ 1$0000180sogs dang*/1$1000180 1$00001801$1000180 / mgon po thugs che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// bde bzhin bshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge ba'i ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// byang chub sems dpa' sa bzhugs pa'i// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su yang*// skur bcas skur 466) ni med pa yi// mchod rten rnams la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal// phyag byar 'os pa thamasacad la// zhes sogs kyis phyag 'tshal lo/

mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*// snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*// gdug dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra /bla ma'i tshogs dang dkon mchog mchod// 'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par// bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis pa// blo yis blangs te dbul bar bgyi/ /rab dang yid la byung gyur pa'i// mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa du ma yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sras bcas mchod// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dngos po rnams// gus pa khyed la dbul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa'i// yon gnas dam pa khyod rnams kyis/ bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas// 467) bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// de nas dngos gzhi sems bskyed pa ni/ mkha' khyab sems can la byams snying rje drag po dang ldan pas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu/ sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin bsgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ci bgyis pa dang bgyid du rtsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang*/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di 468) nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi snying po lamachis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/

dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo bar bgyi'o/ zhes lan gsum gyi smon sems skyes par nges shes bya zhing*/ de'i bslab bya rnams la 'bad do/ spro na/ deng 'dir bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// sogs kyi gzengs bstod pa yang bya la/ bsdu na/ byang chub sems mchog rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med par yang*// gong nas gong nas 'phel bar shog /ces smon lam gdab bo/ de ltar smon sems bskyed nas/ ༈ 'jug pa'i 469) sdom pa blang ba la yang gsol ba gdab pa/ 'dun pa gso ba/ myur du bskul ba/ bar chad dang mi ldan par khas blangs shing bslab pa dngos len pa rnams kyi dang po ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar len par 'tshal gyi/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad gsan cing rtsal ba'i rigs so/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di ltar bdag sems can ma bsgral ba bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol ba rnams 'grol ba dang*/ dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdungargyun mi chad par 'dod cing*/ dedag la bdag sems bskyed 470) pa brtan pa dang yid dam brtan par bgyi'o/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal du 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab ste/ dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul/ bdag pos yongs su ma bzung dang*/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te dbul// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po kun/ /ma lus dkon mchog spyan sngar 'bul// 'gro ba'i skyabs gyur 'tshang rgya shog

/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang bar myur du rtsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ bzhi pa ni/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi pa smon pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' lags shing byang chub smon lam btab pa lags pas na/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab 471) pa'i gzhi dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims de dag sangs rgyas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams las blang bar 'tshal lo/ zhes lan gcig brjod la/ blang ba ni/ med snang 'khrul ba'i sdug bsngal la rtag tu spyod pa'i sems can rnams sgrol phyir bdag gis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims blang nas bsrung ste sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa rtse gcig pas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs pa dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol bar 'tshal te/ de dag gi spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims gang la slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad slob par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu na da lta byung 472) ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da lta slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims de thams cad bdag gis yang dag par blang ngo*/ zhes lan gsum gyi 'jug pa byang sems yongs su rdzogs pa sngar ma thob pa thob cing*/ thob pas gso sbyong du 'gyur bas/

de ltar nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ mjug chog mkhyen par gsol zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dpang du gyur par phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa dag tu bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur gyur kyang lkog tu ma gyur ba'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol/ 473) zhes lan gsum brjod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba de dag thams cad bdag gi sdom pa'i dpang po lta bur mdzad par mos shing*/ las ci la thug kyang sdom pa las mi 'da' bar bya'o/ byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung ste// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /byang chub sems kyi yon du 'bul// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// byang chub mchog la spyod par shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la bde 'byor shog /ces sogs smon lam rgya cher gdab bo/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi byang sdom len pa'i rim pa/ thun bar pa'i nyams len rdzogs so/ ༈ smaun 'jug don dam zung 'jug tu nyams su len thabs 474) 'gro mgon klu grub zhabs kyis mdzad pa la/ sbyor ba tshogs bsags/ dngos gzhi skyabs sems khyad par ba/ rjes bsngo smon rnams mthar chags su ston pa'i nyams len tshig don 'dre bar bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i bde bzhin bshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ dam pa'i chos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba thog ma dang tha ma mchis pa'i 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang pha ma dang sems can dag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las bgyis pa dang bgyid du stsal ba dang bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba ci mchis pa de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms 475) te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar bla na med pas so sor bachags so/ mi 'chab bo/ slan chad 'di lta bu mi bgyid do/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cadabadag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bsod nams kyi rjes su yi rang ba bla na med pa thugs chung ba de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas dang 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad dang*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa'i bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi chad par bya ba'i slad du dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang rkang gnyis kyi gtso la skyabs su 476)mchi ste/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba skyes bu chen po skyes bu khyu mchog bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sku bla na med pa'i sku chos kyi sku mnga' ba la skyabasasu lamachi'o/ chos 'dod dang bral ba'i mchog la skyabs su mchi ste/ bla na med pa'i bde bzhin bshegs pa la mnga' ba zhi ba chos kyi sku so so rang gi rig pa skyabs su mchi'o/ dge 'dun 'dul ba'i tshogs kyi mchog la skyabs su 'chi ste/ phyogs bzhi'i 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po' dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la gnas kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la// dus ji lta ba dang stobs ci mchis pa bzhin du 477) bdag 'bul zhing mchis na/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa dag /bdag bzhes su gsol/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde bzhin bshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang sems can thams cad 'grol ba dang sems can thams cad dbugs dbyung ba dang sems can thams cad mya ngan las zlo ba dang sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god pa'i slad du/ ji ltar bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sems can thams cad sgrol ba dang sems can thams cad 'grol ba dang sems can thams cad dbyugs dbyung ba dang sems can thams cad yongs su mya ngan las zlo ba dang sems can thams cad thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 'god 478)pa'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ ༈ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag gis/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa/ chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid kyi rang gi sems gdod nas ma skyes pa stong pa nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde bzhin bshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis/
